title: Date Center Technician, Data Center Operations
description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 We are looking for Data Center Technicians to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team. Data Center Technicians are the primary resolver and troubleshoot and solve a range of data center infrastructure issues including, but not limited to: hardware, fiber, networking, and related problems. You will be part of the Data Center Operations (DCO) team, overseeing the operation and maintenance of the IT infrastructure and hardware for data centers in AWS Cloud regions. You will become the primary resolver for your support team, and gain troubleshooting skills on different hardware and software cases. You will be able to troubleshoot and solve most infrastructure issues and engage other appropriate solutions groups on more complex problems to drive solutions.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**Skills**
 This is a customer-facing role that requires strong technical, communication, and problem-solving skills. Your activities will include (but not limited to):
   

  

* Build relationships with internal teams and customers along with innovating effective solutions to meet issues & problems as they arise
* Conducting site assessments at various facilities to proactively prepare for the onsite installation of AWS equipment
* Installing/expanding/provisioning AWS infrastructure at the third-party premises, data center, and/or non-traditional environment
* Troubleshooting hardware, network installations & configurations and performing network testing, break/fix, rack installations and/or decommissioning and solving complex problems
* Proactively identifying and implementing strategies that prevent support issues and/or further enhance the customer experience
* Process and track purchase orders for data center hardware components
* Monitor spare parts inventory levels and initiate replenishment orders
* Maintain accurate records in internal ordering databases
* Execute asset transfers across global locations
* Track order approvals and provide timely updates to stakeholders
* Identify and report shipment issues, including delays, cancellations, and expedited requests
* Manage shipment label distribution for new equipment and returns
* Coordinate with global teams to ensure timely delivery and resolution of issue
* Conduct day-to-day business, both internally and with external customers
* Required travel up to 25% on average. You will be required to travel between locations to install, service, and retrieve AWS equipment.
* Physical ability to push and/or pull heavy objects into position (regularly lift up to 18kg and participate in team lifts of 30 kg)
* May lead or participate in efforts to develop standard operating procedures (SOPs) and tools that improve operational efficiencies
* May lead larger projects that require cross-functional alignment and support, including large-DC installations, global-reaching business initiatives, and/or development of mechanisms to support growth to ensure compliance with global group standards.
* May be required to work at height to maintain AWS infrastructure equipment while adhering to AWS health & safety guidelines.
* Most of all, you will have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!


**About The Team**
 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 4+ years of data center engineering or operations experience
* Knowledge of fundamentals of hardware, networking, security, databases (relational or NoSQL), operating systems (Unix, Linux, and/or Windows)
* 2+ years of leading large complex programs experience
* A valid (EU) driving license is required as Data Centers may not have any public transportation available nearby.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree, or 4+ years of relevant technical position experience
* Experience working in a customer-facing environment
* CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, Cisco/CCNA, Linux (Redhat), Hardware (installation), AWS, or other industry relevant certifications
* Knowledge of power, cooling, cabling, networking hardware, inventory management, and automation
* Proficiency in network operating systems (Cisco IOS, NX-OS, Junos)


 Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.
   

  

 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Data Engineer
description:

 Data Engineer

 5+ years

 Stockholm, Sweden

 Full-time | Permanent position
 



  





**Tata consultancy Services** 
 is an IT services, consulting and business solutions organization that has been partnering with many of the world’s largest businesses for the past 50 years. We believe innovation and collective knowledge can transform all our futures with greater purpose. We help companies across industries achieve their strategic goals and lead their digital transformation programs. With 600,000 experts globally and 18,000+ consultants working for leading Nordic Customers, we have a strong sense of purpose for the ecosystem around us – our employees, partners, customers and society.
 



  





**About the role** 




 Are you an experienced Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data solutions and working close to both technology and business? This is an opportunity to join a high-performing engineering environment where you will contribute to the development and maintenance of modern data pipelines across on-premise and cloud environments.
 



  





 In this role, you will be part of an agile squad and take an active role in developing pipelines, analyzing failures, fixing bugs, and ensuring that data flows are robust, efficient, and aligned with business needs.
 



  





 You will work with technologies such as PySpark, Apache Airflow, SQL, AWS Redshift, Git, GitHub Actions, JFrog, Kubernetes, DBT, CloudWatch and Redshift Console, helping to support advanced analytics and data-driven decision-making.

* Develop data processes and workflows using tools such as PySpark and Apache Airflow.
* Support and enhance data platforms, databases and data warehouses to enable advanced analytics.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and JFrog for automated deployment and version control.
* Troubleshoot data pipelines and resolve issues related to real-time processing, batch processing and integrations.



  





**About you** 




 We believe you are a hands-on Data Engineer with a strong technical foundation and a genuine interest in building data solutions that create business value. You enjoy working in an agile team setup, collaborating with different stakeholders and taking ownership from development to troubleshooting and continuous improvement.
 



  





 You are comfortable working with complex data environments and have a structured approach to quality, performance and governance. You also enjoy solving problems, optimizing pipelines and contributing to scalable data engineering practices.
 



  





**Qualifications:** 



* 5+ years of experience in data engineering, preferably within cloud data warehouse environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.
* Strong hands-on experience with PySpark and Apache Airflow.
* Strong SQL skills and a deep understanding of query performance.
* Solid understanding of data modelling principles, including dimensional modelling, Kimball, normalized models and hybrid strategies.
* Experience with AWS Redshift, including WLM, distribution and sort keys, query execution plan analysis and optimization techniques.
* Familiarity with monitoring tools such as CloudWatch and Redshift Console.
* Experience with data versioning, CI/CD, Git, Kubernetes and collaborative development practices in DBT.
* Fluent in
 **English** 
 (written and spoken)

* Wellness Allowance
* 30 Days of Annual Vacation

* Competitive Pension Plan (ITP1)
* Salary Sacrifice Pension Scheme through SPP
* Pension Advisory Services through SPP
* Skandia Group Insurances
* Access to the Benifex Benefits Portal with Exclusive Discounts
* Continuous Learning, Training and Development Opportunities
* Access to world-class learning platforms
* Long-Term Career Growth within a Global Organization



  





**Ready to make an impact?** 




 Join a company where innovation, collaboration, and continuous development are part of everyday life!

title: Information Security Manager
description:
Education is one of the world's most important systems. At Kognity, we develop technology that enhances its effectiveness for both the teachers delivering it and the students who rely on it. The problems are real, the work is challenging, and the results show up in classrooms every day.
   

  

 We're a 125-person EdTech scale-up powering learning in 140+ countries, helping students and teachers thrive through an intelligent platform that combines rich, interactive pedagogy with smart AI and data.
   

  

**Why join Kognity?**
* Work on problems that matter – Your work directly influences the lives of teachers and students in over 100 countries. The scale is global, and the outcomes are tangible.
* High ownership, high expectations – You are trusted to take initiative, make decisions and drive outcomes. Responsibility comes early, accountability is real, and results matter.
* A fast-moving, high-performing team – You will work with smart, driven colleagues across the globe on complex problems. Standards and expectations are high, feedback is direct, and the pace is fast.
* Continuous growth is the baseline – Everyone is expected and supported to learn quickly, improve constantly and raise their own bar. If you enjoy responsibility, momentum and meaningful challenge, you will thrive here.


**What You'll Do**
 As an
 **Information Security Manager** 
 you will get a chance to take ownership of Kognity's information security programme, keeping certifications like SOC 2 and ISO live and evolving, and driving incident response and customer trust for a platform used in classrooms across 120+ countries. You will:
   

  

* Take full ownership of Kognity's information security certifications and the policies behind them, turning a complex compliance landscape into a dependable system.
* Manage Kognity's incident response plan and strategy for data breaches, ensuring the business can respond quickly and confidently if an incident occurs.
* Oversee the IT and data security of Kognity's web systems, including banking security, keeping customer and company data protected across our platform.
* Lead customer information security dialogues and respond to RFPs, building Kognity's reputation as a partner customers can trust with their data.
* Manage physical security across Kognity's premises, keeping security risks to our offices and people to a minimum.
* Provide day-to-day support to teams across Kognity on information security questions, keeping good security practice a part of how people work rather than an afterthought.


**What We're Looking For**
* Experience working with information security frameworks (SOC2, ISO 27000 and ISO 42000) and ownership of an information security set-up end to end.
* A collaborative approach, comfortable managing security-related projects across functions such as Legal, Engineering, and Commercial.
* A commercial mindset, understanding how information security not only protects Kognity but also drives customer trust and business success.
* A passion for AI and a drive to experiment with new tools to enhance creativity, decisions, and execution.


**Our Values**
* We take ownership
* We are transparent
* We make every week count
* We obsess over customers
* We show up with heart


**How We Hire**
* Discovery call with a Recruiter
* Hiring manager discussion
* Case study
* Values discussion
* Leadership talk
* References

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
**Vill du ta nästa steg från teknisk specialist till rådgivande Technical Account Manager?** 




 Här hos oss på Advania Real Estate får du kombinera avancerad teknisk felsökning med ett växande ansvar för egna kunder. Det här är en
 **teknisk specialistroll** 
 med en
 **tydlig väg mot Technical Account Management.** 
 Du arbetar både med tredje linjens support och kundnära rådgivning, där ansvaret för egna kunder växer i takt med din erfarenhet och utveckling.
 



  





 I rollen kombinerar du avancerad teknisk problemlösning med nära samarbete och dialog med kunder. Successivt får du ett större eget kundansvar samtidigt som du fortsätter att fördjupa din tekniska kompetens. På sikt finns en tydlig utvecklingsväg mot en senior roll med större kunder, mer strategisk rådgivning och ett utökat tekniskt ansvar.
 



  





 Inom Real Estate arbetar vi med säker och skalbar digitalisering av fastighetsbolag genom traditionell fastighets IT, IoT och rådgivning.🤩
 



  





**Din vardag som Technical Account Manager** 




 Som Technical Account Manager är du länken mellan kundens verksamhet och Advanias tekniska leveranser. Du arbetar både med avancerad teknisk support och nära kunddialog för att skapa långsiktigt värde.
 



  





 I rollen kommer du bland annat att:
 


* felsöka och hantera komplexa incidenter
* genomföra rotorsaksanalyser och analysera loggar
* implementera tekniska lösningar och delta i förändringsarbete
* ge tekniska rekommendationer utifrån kundernas behov
* dokumentera lösningar och förbättringsförslag
* samarbeta med kunder och interna specialister för att säkerställa hög kvalitet i leveransen



  





**Hur du bygger förtroende hos kunden** 




 Du arbetar nära kunden och bygger förtroende genom att förstå verksamhetens behov och kommunicera tekniska frågor på ett tydligt sätt. Rollen präglas av självledarskap, där du tar ansvar för att driva ditt arbete framåt samtidigt som du samarbetar nära kollegor och specialister för att skapa värde för kunden. ✨
 



  





**Din erfarenhet och kompetens** 




 Du har några års erfarenhet inom IT och vill kombinera tekniskt specialistarbete med ett växande ansvar i dialogen med kunder.
 



  





 För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har erfarenhet av flera av följande områden:
 


* tredje linjens support
* avancerad felsökning och incidenthantering
* kunders IT miljöer och tekniska plattformar
* problemhantering och förändringshantering
* Microsoftbaserade miljöer, nätverk och molntjänster



  





 Du har ett analytiskt arbetssätt och kan självständigt felsöka problem, analysera loggar och identifiera grundorsaker till tekniska incidenter.
 



  





 Meriterande erfarenheter
 


* Managed Served Provider eller outsourcingverksamhet
* implementationer och tekniska förändringsprojekt
* tekniska kunddialoger eller eget kundansvar
* Azure eller Microsoft 365 certifieringar
* större driftmiljöer eller fastighetsbranschen



  





 Vi förväntar oss inte att du ska ha erfarenhet av allt ovan. Det viktigaste är att du har en stabil teknisk grund, ett intresse för att arbeta nära kund och en vilja att utvecklas mot en mer rådgivande roll med ökat kundansvar.
 



  





**Hos oss får du** 




 Här hos oss på Real Estate får du arbeta nära erfarna Technical Account Managers och tekniska specialister i en miljö som präglas av samarbete, kunskapsdelning och hög teknisk kompetens. Här kombinerar du avancerad teknik med kunddialog och får möjlighet att utvecklas i takt med rollen.💜
 



  





 Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! 👋
 



  





 Visa gärna ditt intresse så snart som möjligt då vi intervjuar löpande. Vi välkomnar sökanden med olika bakgrunder, erfarenheter och synsätt, eftersom vi vet att en bredare mångfald berikar var och en av oss och stärker såväl effektivitet som kreativitet i vårt arbete.
 



  





 Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomgår våra slutkandidater en obligatorisk bakgrundskontroll, en för oss kvalitativ kontroll inför ett anställningsbeslut. Advania samarbetar med Ljung & Sjöberg i ärenden kopplat till alkohol-, drog- och spelproblematik och är en certifierad "Proaktiv Arbetsplats".
 



  





 Tveka inte att höra av dig om du har några frågor eller funderingar.☀️

title: Power Platform Management Consultant | Modern Workplace
description:

You get a company purpose-built for business-critical, leading-edge technology solutions, committed to improving the way humans work, interact, and live. It’s all here, so take a closer look!

title: Cloud Platform Engineer
description:
Ansök nu
   

  

* Urval sker löpande
* Stockholm
* Arbete på plats

 Du har jobbat några år nu. Du är antagligen den i ditt nuvarande team som alltid tjatar om att "vi borde automatisera det där", men möts av gamla processer och färdiga mallar. Det är tryggt, men trångt.
   

  

 Men handen på hjärtat: Vill du bara följa kartan, eller vill du vara med och rita den?

 Kvalifikationer

**Kaffe före CV?** 
 Vi bryr oss mer om vart du är på väg än exakt vad du gjorde 2019. Känner du igen dig i Framåtrörelsen?
   

  

 Låt oss ta en kaffe och snacka om hur vi bygger framtidens team. Ansök nu eller hör av dig direkt!

title: OSS Engineer

From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

*In this role, you will play a key role in:*
* Leading the Design, Architecture, and Implementation of BSS and OSS platforms to support telecom operations.

* Our array of career growth programs and diverse professions are crafted to support you in exploring a world of opportunities.

**Application**
 As part of our recruitment process, identity verification or background checks may occasionally be conducted.

title: Tech Lead - Credit & Fraud
description:
**What We Do At Qliro**
 At Qliro we deliver safe and simple payments. We are a dedicated partner to our merchants who serve their customers every day. We believe that if our merchants grow, we grow. We are a company of dedicated, friendly and highly competent people that together have redefined what Qliro and payments can be. We are now on a journey of scaling our business both here in Sweden and the Nordics.
   

  

 What your team does
   

  

 We’re looking for a Senior Tech Lead to own the technical direction of our Credit & Fraud team, the team at the center of Qliro’s Pay Later platform. What we do here shapes whether customers can pay in a way that actually works for them, and whether we protect them from taking on debt they can’t handle. It’s a dual responsibility, and we take both sides seriously.
   

  

 We’re rebuilding the next generation of this system from the ground up, designed to handle a significant increase in transaction volumes as we scale. Part of what you’ll lead is making this platform ready to operate beyond the Nordics, so the architectural decisions you make now will need to hold up across multiple markets. We’re in the early stages of exploring how AI can help us make better credit and fraud decisions, and we’re honest that this is genuinely complex territory. Credit is one of the most regulated areas when it comes to AI: explainability, fairness, and auditability aren’t optional. We want someone who finds that complexity interesting, not someone who pretends it isn’t there.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

 You’ll own the technical direction of the team and write production-grade .NET yourself, not occasionally, but regularly. You’ll make architectural decisions you can defend, drive performance and scale from the start, and treat observability and decision traceability as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts.
   

  

 Credit and fraud touch nearly everything at Qliro, which means you’ll work across a wide range of stakeholders: product, risk, compliance, other engineering teams. You’ll be the person who can hold a technical position in a room full of people with competing priorities, make a call under ambiguity, and bring clarity when there’s none. You’ll understand the regulatory and compliance landscape well enough to know what constraints you’re building within.
   

  

 You’ll set others up to succeed. Not in a formal, structured way, but in the way that actually matters: sharing hard-won knowledge, asking the right questions, and making the engineers around you better at their craft.
   

  

 What you'll bring to the team
   

  

* You’ve led technical work on systems where getting it wrong had real consequences, ideally in credit, fraud, risk, or payments, or in a high-transaction financial environment where you’ve developed that instinct.
* You’re comfortable operating in a heavily regulated environment and understand that compliance constraints aren’t obstacles to good engineering, they’re part of it.
* You understand that in this domain, correctness matters as much as speed, and you build accordingly.
* You’ve driven platform transformations before, not just worked on greenfield projects. You know what it means to move away from one system while keeping it running, and you bring the mindset to finish that job rather than work around it.
* You have opinions about what good looks like, production-grade code, observable systems, sensible tradeoffs and you’re not precious about being challenged on them.
* You’re comfortable being the one who decides when there’s no perfect answer, and you’re open to being wrong.
* You don’t wait for a perfect spec to start thinking.


 How we work
   

  

 Engineering ownership here is real. Engineers make calls that matter and are trusted to defend them. How your team works day to day — how often you’re in the office, how you structure your time — is something teams decide for themselves. We’re based in Stockholm, but we’ve found that trusting teams to figure out their own rhythm works better than a company-wide policy.
   

  

 Does this sound like your next role? What are you waiting for - apply now!
   

  

*Qliro is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, religion or other beliefs, disability, sexual* 
 orientation
 *or age* 
 .

title: Staff Engineering Operations Manager
description:
We're not here to add to the noise. We're here to cut through it- with AI that actually works for marketers.
   

  

 From AI-powered content creation to world-class CMS and the industry's most trusted experimentation platform, Optimizely is the tool modern marketers actually want to use. AI-Ready. Set. Go.
   

  

 10,000+ brands including H&M, PayPal, and Zoom already get it. So do Gartner, Forrester, and IDC, who consistently recognize us as leaders in MarTech.
   

  

 But here's the thing about building great products: it takes great people. Our 1,600+ Optimizers across 12 global offices are curious, collaborative, and refreshingly human. We don't do corporate speak. We do real conversations, big ideas, and genuinely care for the work we make together.
   

  

 If you want to be part of a team that's shaping the future of marketing technology — and actually enjoys doing it — you're in the right place.
   

  

 Find us on Instagram: @optimizely
   

  

**Introduction**
 Optimizely is expanding its global operational capability and is now looking for a Situation Manager / Incident Commander to strengthen our Incident response function. In this role, you will lead real-time command of high-severity incidents across Optimizely’s DXP platform—including CMS, Commerce, PaaS, and cloud hosting in Azure and GCP.
   

  

 This is a high-impact operational leadership role where you coordinate cross-functional teams, maintain situational awareness, and drive rapid restoration of service for customers across the globe.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Act as the Incident Commander for high-severity incidents, ensuring fast, structured, and coordinated response.
* Maintain full situational awareness and manage the incident timeline, scope, communications, and decision-making.
* Lead Engineering, SRE, Support, and Customer Success teams through the incident lifecycle.
* Own clear communication to internal stakeholders, including executives, product teams, and customer-facing groups.
* Provide customer-facing status updates during Major Incidents and ensure external communication standards are met.
* Run structured incident bridges, drive focus, and ensure that actions, responsibilities, and follow-ups are clear.
* Ensure accurate incident documentation and support the delivery of Incident Reports, RFO/RCA, and executive summaries.
* Drive continuous improvement of Incident processes, including detection, escalation rules, and communication workflows.
* Contribute to the development of playbooks, runbooks, and automation to reduce MTTR and improve reliability.
* Be part of the global on-call rotation to support 24/7 coverage with a strong focus on EMEA hours.


**Knowledge And Experience**
* Demonstrated experience as an Incident Commander, Situation Manager, or Incident Lead in SaaS, PaaS, or hosting operations.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams under pressure and make structured, high-quality decisions quickly.
* Deep understanding of operational frameworks such as ITIL Incident Management.
* Strong communication skills, clear, assertive, and calm, capable of handling both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience coordinating incidents involving distributed, cloud-based systems (Azure and/or GCP is a plus).
* Strong situational awareness, ability to prioritize signal over noise, and maintain control of high-pressure calls.
* Experience with customer communication during critical events.
* Fluent in English and Swedish.
* Background in Engineering, SRE, or Technical Operations.
* Experience with multi-cloud environments or large-scale global SaaS platforms.
* Experience with Application Insights, Datadog, or similar observability tools.


**Education**
 Bachelor’s Degree (Computer Science or engineering preferred) or equivalent work experience
   

  

**Competencies**
 Optimizely is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Optimizely is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

title: IT Security Engineer till internationell high-tech-miljö
description:
Vill du arbeta brett inom cybersäkerhet och få möjlighet att påverka hur en säker IT-miljö faktiskt byggs upp? Här kliver du in i en teknikintensiv och internationell verksamhet där robusthet, säkerhet och tillgänglighet är avgörande – och där du får arbeta hands-on med allt från säkerhetsövervakning och identitetshantering till nätverk, cloud och endpoint security.
 



  





 Det här är en möjlighet för dig som vill mer än att enbart förvalta befintliga säkerhetslösningar. Du kommer in i ett skede där mycket redan finns på plats, samtidigt som det finns stor möjlighet att vidareutveckla, strukturera och sätta din prägel på hur organisationen arbetar med IT-säkerhet framåt.
 



  





**Om tjänsten** 




 Som IT Security Engineer får du en bred teknisk roll i gränslandet mellan cybersäkerhet, nätverk och modern IT-infrastruktur. Verksamheten består av flera typer av tekniska miljöer – bland annat utvecklings-, produktions- och kontorsmiljöer – där säkerheten behöver fungera både i cloud och i fysisk infrastruktur.
 



  





 Det som särskiljer möjligheten är bredden. I stället för att arbeta med en avgränsad del av cybersäkerhet får du följa säkerheten hela vägen – från nätverk och endpoints till identitet, cloud, loggning och compliance.
 



  





 Du kommer dessutom in i en organisation med avancerad egen teknik, internationella samarbeten och höga krav på säkerhet och robusthet. Säkerhetsarbetet är under fortsatt utveckling, vilket innebär att du inte bara tar över någon annans lösning – du får vara med och forma hur den ska se ut framåt.
 



  





 För rätt person finns därför stora möjligheter att både bredda sin tekniska kompetens och få ett betydande ansvar inom ett område som står högt på agendan.
 



  





**Arbetsuppgifter** 




 En stor del av rollen handlar om att säkerställa att rätt säkerhetsnivå finns på plats när nya miljöer, system och tekniska lösningar etableras. Det kan exempelvis innebära att sätta upp säkerhetsövervakning och loggning för en ny miljö, konfigurera nätverkssegment och brandväggsregler, säkra klienter och servrar eller säkerställa rätt behörigheter i Azure.
 



  





 Du kommer samtidigt att vara med och utveckla organisationens övergripande säkerhetsförmåga. Här finns utrymme att identifiera förbättringsområden, föreslå lösningar och omsätta säkerhetskrav och ramverk till praktisk teknik.
 



  





 Rollen innebär även nära samarbete med tekniska kollegor internationellt, vilket ger dig möjlighet att arbeta med säkerhetsfrågor över flera miljöer och geografier.
 



  





 Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:
 


* Bygga vidare på organisationens lösningar för säkerhetsövervakning, logghantering och SIEM
* Säkerställa att klienter och servrar har rätt skydd, exempelvis EDR, säkerhetssensorer och loggning
* Arbeta med segmentering av nätverk samt konfigurera switchar, brandväggar och säkerhetsregler
* Hantera identiteter, roller, behörigheter och åtkomst i Azure
* Arbeta med endpoint management och säkerhetspolicies, exempelvis genom Intune
* Delta vid etablering av nya tekniska miljöer och säkerställa att security by design genomsyrar lösningen
* Arbeta med sårbarhetshantering, härdning och andra tekniska säkerhetsåtgärder
* Dokumentera förändringar, säkerhetskonfigurationer och arbetssätt
* Bidra till att utveckla organisationens säkerhetsarbete utifrån etablerade ramverk och compliance-krav



  





**Vi söker dig som** 



* Har relevant eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT, cybersäkerhet eller motsvarande
* Har praktisk, hands-on erfarenhet av IT- eller cybersäkerhet i säkerhetskritiska miljöer, gärna från försvarsindustrin eller andra säkerhetskänsliga miljöer
* Har mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska



  





 Det är meriterande om du tidigare har arbetat i exempelvis en SOC, varit med och byggt upp eller utvecklat en IT-säkerhetsmiljö eller har erfarenhet av Azure, Intune och moderna cloudmiljöer.
 



  





 Vi tror att du är nyfiken på hela säkerhetsområdet och gillar att förstå hur tekniken faktiskt hänger ihop. Du behöver inte vilja nischa dig mot endast ett verktyg eller en del av cybersäkerheten – tvärtom passar rollen dig som tycker om kombinationen av nätverk, cloud, klienter, identitet och säkerhetsövervakning.
 



  





 Du är initiativtagande och bekväm med att identifiera vad som behöver förbättras, komma med förslag och själv driva arbetet framåt. Samtidigt arbetar du strukturerat och förstår vikten av dokumentation, spårbarhet och tydliga processer i en säkerhetskritisk miljö.
 



 Framför allt motiveras du av möjligheten att vara med och bygga. Här finns stor frihet att påverka hur säkerhetsmiljön ska utvecklas, och bra idéer har kort väg från förslag till genomförande.
 



  





**Om anställningen** 




 Detta är ett konsultuppdrag vilket innebär att du kommer att var anställd av Friday och arbeta som konsult ute hos vår kund. Tanken är att anställningen efter ca 12 månader övergår i en anställning hos kund.
 



  





**Övrig info** 



* Omfattning: Heltid
* Start: Enligt överenskommelse
* Placering: Stockholm
* Lön: Marknadsmässig månadslön
* Kontaktperson: Anna Persson



  





**Om Friday** 




 På Friday brinner vi för att ge dig som Tech-talang en riktigt bra start på karriären. Genom att lyssna på vad just du vill och drivs av, matchar vi dig med företag och möjligheter som får dig att se fram emot att gå till jobbet.
 



  





 Vi värderar ambition och potential högt och arbetar aktivt för en fördomsfri rekrytering, där alla ges samma chans att lyckas.
 



  





 Vi finns i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Linköping och Örebro. Varje år genomför vi över 5 000 karriärmöten och matchar kandidater med allt från globala företag till innovativa startups.

title: Presales Team Lead
description:
**Role:** 
 Presales Lead – SAP Solutions (S/4HANA & Manufacturing Focus)
 



**Experience (Years):** 
 15+ years
 



**Language requirement:** 
 Swedish & English
 



  





**Tata consultancy Services** 
 is an IT services, consulting and business solutions organization that has been partnering with many of the world’s largest businesses for the past 50 years. We believe innovation and collective knowledge can transform all our futures with greater purpose. We help companies across industries achieve their strategic goals and lead their digital transformation programs. With 600,000 experts globally and 18,000+ consultants working for leading Nordic Customers, we have a strong sense of purpose for the ecosystem around us – our employees, partners, customers and society.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 We are seeking a dynamic Presales Lead with 15+ years of experience to drive presales and solutioning activities for SAP-focused engagements, with a particular emphasis on S/4HANA business solutioning in the Manufacturing domain. The ideal candidate will independently manage RFP/RFI responses, craft compelling proposals, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-value SAP solutions that address client business needs.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**SAP S/4HANA Solutioning & Presales** 




  




* Lead the creation of business-focused SAP S/4HANA solutions tailored to client requirements, especially for Manufacturing industry clients.
* Respond to RFPs/RFIs with value-driven proposals, focusing on SAP S/4HANA transformation programs, assessments, and cloud solutions.
* Articulate business value and competitive differentiation of SAP S/4HANA solutions, especially in early sales cycle stages.
* Support acquisition of new customer logos and contribute to overall portfolio growth strategy.



  





**Manufacturing Domain Expertise** 




  




* Demonstrate deep understanding of manufacturing business processes, industry trends, and challenges.
* Position SAP S/4HANA as a strategic enabler for digital transformation in manufacturing, including automation, supply chain optimization, and production planning.



  





**Functional SAP S/4HANA Modules (Expertise in at least a few of these areas)** 




  




* SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI/CO)
* SAP S/4HANA Sales & Distribution (SD)
* SAP S/4HANA Materials Management (MM)
* SAP S/4HANA Production Planning (PP)
* SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance (PM)
* SAP S/4HANA Quality Management (QM)
* SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain (SCM)
* SAP S/4HANA Manufacturing (Discrete & Process)
* SAP S/4HANA Procurement
* SAP S/4HANA Analytics & Reporting



  





**Bid Management** 




  




* Own the end-to-end bid process, including RFP/RFI analysis, response strategy, proposal writing, pricing coordination, and submission timelines.
* Ensure compliance with internal bid governance processes and client requirements.



  





**Stakeholder Coordination** 




  




* Collaborate with sales, delivery, finance, and legal teams to gather inputs and finalize proposals.
* Engage with clients through discussions, presentations, and workshops to support sales and solutioning efforts.



  





**Knowledge Management** 




  




* Maintain a repository of reusable assets, case studies, and templates to accelerate future bids.



  





**Governance & Delivery Support** 




  




* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction across SAP programs and engagements.
* Provide updates to client senior management and participate in steering committees as needed.



  





**Required Qualifications & Experience** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, Computer Science, or related field; MBA preferred.
* 10+ years of experience in presales, solutioning, or bid management roles, with a strong focus on SAP solutions (especially S/4HANA).
* Proven track record of independently managing large and complex RFP/RFI responses for SAP projects.
* Strong understanding of SAP business processes, digital transformation, and cloud/infrastructure domains.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in tools like MS Office, SharePoint, and bid management platforms.



  





**Preferred Attributes** 




  




* Experience working with global clients in sectors such as Manufacturing, Telecom, BFSI, or Retail.
* Exposure to AI-led platforms, automation, and hybrid cloud solutions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work under tight deadlines and manage multiple bids simultaneously.
* Willingness to travel for client workshops or solution presentations.
* Experience in global delivery models and multicultural environments.



  





**Does that sound interesting?** 




  





 You are welcome to submit your application consisting of your CV, personal letter, relevant degrees or certifications details, professional references, etc. We work with ongoing recruitment so send in your application as soon as possible.
 



  





 We look forward to receiving your application via LinkedIn or mail to
 **aswini.ranganathan@tcs.com**

title: Medgrundare
description:
**Stockholm / Hybrid · Full-time or alongside your current role · Significant equity · No salary initially** 
**·** 
**Build the next Nordic fintech leader** 




  





 We're not looking for an employee. We're looking for the person who wants to build the next Nordic fintech leader with us.
 



  





 ContoAI is building an AI-native financial platform with the ambition to become a leading fintech company in the Nordics. We already have a working product and early pilot customers — and we're looking for an exceptional
 **Co-Founder & CTO** 
 who wants to build the company, the product and the technology together with us.
 



 This is not a traditional CTO position.
 



 You will join as a true co-founder, with meaningful ownership and significant influence over the company. Initially, you'll be highly hands-on — designing architecture, writing production code, building integrations and shipping product. Over time, the natural ambition is for you to recruit and lead a world-class engineering team.
 



 What matters to us is not where you work today — but whether you have the ability, ambition and commitment to build something significant with us.
 



**Our ambition is clear:** 
 build one of the leading fintech companies in the Nordics — and ultimately Europe.
 



  





**What you will build** 




 As Co-Founder & CTO, you'll take ownership of ContoAI's technical development. That includes:
 


* Evolving our core platform from MVP to a hardened, scalable, secure product
* Designing scalable and secure backend architecture
* Developing robust API integrations with banks, PSPs, accounting platforms and other financial infrastructure providers
* Building payment and transaction flows
* Developing AI-native financial workflows and automation
* Integrating LLMs and other AI technologies deeply into the product
* Building intelligent agents and automated financial processes
* Creating secure authentication, permissions and access-control systems
* Designing our data architecture and infrastructure
* Building customer-facing and internal applications
* Establishing testing, deployment, monitoring and DevOps infrastructure
* Ensuring security, reliability and regulatory readiness from the beginning
* Eventually recruiting and leading a world-class engineering team



 You'll work closely with the other founders on product, strategy, partnerships, fundraising and expansion.
 



  





**Fintech & financial infrastructure** 




 Experience from fintech is highly valuable. You don't need to be a regulatory lawyer — but you should understand that in fintech, architecture, security, data and regulation need to work together from day one.
 



 Ideally, you understand or have worked with several of the following:
 


* Payments and PSP integrations
* Banking APIs and Open Banking
* PSD2 and the evolving PSD3/PSR framework
* KYC / KYB
* AML and transaction monitoring
* Payment initiation and account information services
* Financial data and reconciliation
* Identity and authentication
* Handling sensitive financial information
* Security and compliance in regulated environments



  





**AI should be part of the architecture** 




 ContoAI is not looking to simply add an AI chatbot on top of a traditional fintech product. We want to build AI into the
 *core* 
 of the platform.
 



 You don't need to be an AI researcher — you need to understand how to turn modern AI capabilities into products people actually use. We value experience with:
 


* LLM APIs and modern AI models
* AI agents and tool calling
* RAG and knowledge systems
* Structured and unstructured financial data
* AI-driven workflow automation
* Model evaluation and monitoring
* Building reliable AI systems for real-world use
* Using AI to dramatically increase development speed internally



  





**Who we're looking for** 




 You are first and foremost a builder. You can take an idea, understand the business problem behind it, and turn it into a working product.
 



 We're less interested in which programming languages you prefer, and more in whether you can build great technology quickly, make good architectural decisions and create products customers love.
 



 You probably have several of the following:
 


* Strong full-stack or backend engineering experience
* Experience building production-grade applications
* Strong API and systems-integration experience
* Experience with cloud infrastructure and scalable architectures
* Strong understanding of databases and data modelling
* Experience with modern AI/LLM technology
* Experience from fintech, payments, banking or financial infrastructure
* Experience taking a product from 0 → 1
* A good understanding of cybersecurity
* Strong product intuition
* Some UX/UI or product design capability



  





**Product & design** 




 You don't need to be a designer, but having an eye for design is a major advantage.
 



 Financial products are often unnecessarily complicated. We want ContoAI to be different: complex infrastructure underneath, an extremely simple experience on top.
 



 You should care about UX, understand how users interact with products, and be comfortable working closely with design — or creating good interfaces yourself when necessary.
 



  





**Start alongside your current role** 




 We understand that exceptional people often already have exceptional jobs. So for the right person, we're open to you joining ContoAI initially alongside your current employment or other commitments.
 



 This could mean starting evenings, weekends or with a defined part-time commitment while we build the product and validate the business — then increasing your commitment as ContoAI develops, reaches commercial milestones and raises external capital. We care more about output, ownership and momentum than hours spent at a desk.
 



 If ContoAI develops as we expect, the natural ambition would be for the CTO role to grow into a full-time commitment as the company scales and the financial conditions allow it.
 



 Any outside employment would of course need to be compatible with your existing obligations, including confidentiality, IP and non-compete requirements.
 



  





**The person** 




 We think you are:
 


* Entrepreneurial and extremely hands-on
* Ambitious and curious
* Commercially minded
* Comfortable moving quickly and operating with limited resources
* Obsessed with building great products
* Excited by AI and financial technology
* Able to make decisions without perfect information
* Someone who takes ownership rather than waits for instructions



 Most importantly: you want to build a
 *company* 
 — not simply have a CTO title.
 



  





**Compensation & ownership** 




 This is a genuine co-founder opportunity, not a traditional salaried CTO position.
 



 There will be no salary initially. Instead, the right person will receive an attractive and meaningful equity package, designed to provide substantial participation in the value we create together.
 



 The exact ownership structure will depend on experience, technical capability, commitment and what you bring to ContoAI. We can structure the equity to reflect both early contribution and increasing commitment over time, creating strong alignment between the founders.
 



 As the company reaches appropriate funding and/or revenue milestones, we expect to introduce a competitive salary. For the right person, the opportunity is to join
 *before* 
 the major value creation has happened.
 



  





**Why ContoAI?** 




 Banking infrastructure is becoming increasingly accessible through APIs. AI is fundamentally changing how software is built and how financial processes can be automated. We believe this creates an opportunity to build a new generation of financial products.
 



 Our goal is not to build a small fintech feature. Our ambition is to build a category-leading Nordic fintech company and, over time, expand internationally.
 



 As Co-Founder & CTO, you'll have the opportunity to:
 


* Own a meaningful part of the company
* Define the technical architecture from the beginning
* Shape the product and business strategy
* Build the engineering organisation
* Work directly with banks, PSPs and financial infrastructure providers
* Develop cutting-edge AI applications for financial services
* Participate in fundraising and strategic partnerships
* Build something with the potential to become a major Nordic technology company



  





**Interested?** 




 You don't need to send us a traditional cover letter. Just tell us:
 


* Who are you?
* What have you built?
* What's the most technically difficult thing you've worked on?
* Why fintech and AI?
* Why would you want to build ContoAI with us?



 Links to GitHub, products, companies or projects you've built are highly appreciated.
 



 And if you're interested but not ready to leave your current position — talk to us anyway.
 



  





**ContoAI** 
 — We're not looking for an employee. We're looking for the person who wants to build the next Nordic fintech leader with us.

title: Teknisk Systemförvaltare till Dibber
description:
**Vill du vara med och utveckla de digitala plattformarna som får våra skolor och förskolor att fungera varje dag?** 




 Lockas du av att vara en del av ett värderingsstyrt bolag där teknik och verksamhet samverkar för att skapa bästa möjliga förutsättningar för lärande och utveckling? Trivs du i en roll där du får ta ansvar för systemförvaltning, integrationer och kontinuerlig utveckling av digitala tjänster? Då kan du vara den vi letar efter till rollen som Teknisk Systemförvaltare hos Dibber Sverige.
 



  





**Om rollen** 




 Som Teknisk Systemförvaltare ansvarar du för den tekniska förvaltningen av Dibbers administrativa plattformar för förskola och skola samt tillhörande integrationer.
 



 Du arbetar i gränslandet mellan verksamhet, leverantörer och IT med fokus på att säkerställa att system, integrationer och informationsflöden fungerar stabilt, säkert och effektivt.
 



 Du ansvarar för den tekniska plattformen och samarbetar nära verksamheten för att säkerställa att teknik, integrationer och processer samverkar för att skapa bästa möjliga förutsättningar för barn, elever och medarbetare.
 



 Rollen innefattar även ett lokalt samordningsansvar för dataskyddsfrågor i Sverige.
 



  





**Huvudsakliga ansvarsområden** 




 ·        Teknisk förvaltning och vidareutveckling av verksamhetskritiska system.
 



 ·        Säkerställa stabila integrationer och informationsflöden mellan olika plattformar.
 



 ·        Hantera konfiguration, tekniska inställningar och behörighetsstyrning.
 



 ·        Koordinera uppgraderingar, releaser och förändringar.
 



 ·        Felsöka, analysera och koordinera hantering av incidenter och problem.
 



 ·        Samordna och följa upp leverantörer och externa partners.
 



 ·        Ansvara för teknisk dokumentation och livscykelhantering.
 



 ·        Delta i projekt och initiativ som stärker Dibbers digitala ekosystem.
 



  





**Dataskydd och regelefterlevnad** 




 Som en del av rollen fungerar du som lokal kontaktperson för dataskyddsfrågor i Sverige. Du samordnar arbetet i den lokala dataskyddsgruppen och samarbetar nära verksamheten samt koncernens globala dataskyddsfunktion för att säkerställa att våra system och digitala tjänster utvecklas och förvaltas i enlighet med gällande krav, riktlinjer och koncernens arbetssätt.
 








**Vem är du?** 




 Vi söker dig som drivs av att skapa ordning, stabilitet och långsiktiga lösningar. Du är analytisk och strukturerad men har samtidigt lätt för att samarbeta med människor med olika perspektiv och kompetenser. Du är kommunikativ och har förmågan att bygga förtroendefulla relationer med verksamhet, leverantörer och tekniska specialister. Du känner dig bekväm både i dialogen med verksamheten och i tekniska diskussioner med leverantörer och specialister.
 



  
 



 Du är trygg i din kompetens och trivs med att ta ansvar. Du vågar fatta beslut, prioritera mellan olika behov och driva ditt arbete framåt samtidigt som du involverar rätt intressenter när det behövs.
 



 För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har:
 



 ·        Erfarenhet av teknisk systemförvaltning, applikationsförvaltning eller liknande roll.
 



 ·        Erfarenhet av SaaS-baserade verksamhetssystem.
 



 ·        God förståelse för integrationer, API:er och dataflöden.
 



 ·        Erfarenhet av leverantörsstyrning och kravhantering.
 



 ·        Förståelse för identitets- och behörighetshantering.
 



 ·        Kunskap om dataskydd och GDPR ur ett systemperspektiv.
 



 ·        God förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.
 



  
 



 Meriterande är erfarenhet av administrativa system inom skola, förskola eller andra verksamheter med många användare och komplexa informationsflöden.
 



  





**Varför Dibber?** 




 Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med system som används av tusentals medarbetare, vårdnadshavare och barn varje dag.
 



 Du får stort eget ansvar, möjlighet att påverka vår framtida systemmiljö och chansen att arbeta i en organisation där samarbete, utveckling och kvalitet står i fokus.
 



 Vi ser stort värde i det personliga mötet och nära samarbete. Därför kombinerar vi flexibilitet med närvaro och arbetar vanligtvis från vårt kontor i Sollentuna cirka tre dagar i veckan.
 



 Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens digitala plattformar inom Dibber? Då ser vi fram emot din ansökan.
 








**Om oss** 




 Dibber etablerades i Sverige 2017 och bedriver idag förskolor, grundskolor, anpassade grundskolor och öppna förskolor. Dibbers huvudkontor ligger i Sollentuna, verksamhet finns i stora delar av Sverige.
 



 Dibber i Sverige är en del av den norska friskolekoncernen Dibber som startades och ägs av två engagerade pedagoger, Randi och Hans Jacob Sundby. Idag driver Dibber mer än 600 förskolor i nio länder över hela världen. 
 



 Vi står upp för livslångt lärande och att hålla oss i framkant inom våra professioner. Vi strävar efter att bygga ett professionellt nätverk där vi lär av varandra och som kan stötta och inspirera. 
 



 Oavsett vilken del av verksamheten som du arbetar inom, blir du en del av ett team som vill göra en skillnad för barn och elever, och deras framtid. Tillsammans skapar vi en inkluderande arbetsplats präglad av hjärtekultur, lärande och utveckling.

title: Solutions Architect, Software and Technology Companies (ISV)
description:
**Description**
 Are you passionate about cloud technology and helping customers innovate?
   

  

 Join our AWS Solutions Architecture team in Sweden and empower Software, SaaS and Technology Companies to innovate at speed and scale with cloud technologies.
   

  

 Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help them make the most of the Cloud. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with organizations at all stages of cloud adoption. Solutions Architects are responsible for creating and presenting technical content and sharing best practices.
   

  

 They work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. They help customer's validate their initiatives from ideation to proof of concept. Solutions Architects lead activities such as architecture reviews, white-boarding sessions, demos and technical workshops. They collaborate with other teams such as account management, professional services, Industry experts, support, service teams and the AWS partner ecosystem.
   

  

 Amongst others you will be part of the design and building of reference architectures, proof of concepts and help customer deploy production workloads on AWS. You will also provide thought leadership and recommendations on cloud architecture, migration, modernization and operation. Build strong technical relationships acting as the voice of the customer internally to influence AWS service roadmaps.
   

  

 At Amazon you will be encouraged and rewarded for doing what is right for the long-term success of the customer. We value your passion to discover, invent and build on behalf of customers.
   

  

 Amazon has always been, and always will be, committed to diversity and inclusion. We seek builders from all backgrounds to join our teams, and we encourage our employees to bring their authentic, original, and best selves to work.
   

  

 AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and dedicated support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Work directly with strategic customers to accelerate their challenging, mission-critical projects and recommend best-practice architectures in line with their long-term business outcomes

* Contribute to the growth of the Solutions Architecture organisation by interviewing candidates and having a voice in hiring decisions. You will also be helping others develop new skills by mentoring team members and identifying talent needs in the organisation.
* Develop areas of depth in technical domains relevant to our outcomes.


 A day in the life
   

  

 You will have the opportunity to work with account managers to help customers accelerate their cloud implementation to modernize their business on AWS. Working with these customers, you will help them transform existing workloads by designing modern target architectures optimized for business agility, innovation, performance, resiliency, cost, security, and more using both native and partner solutions.
   

  

 Our teams focus on understanding customer key business drivers as well as the existing application architecture(s) to deliver a technical recommendation to the customer with a goal of designing a robust cloud architecture that can scale as their business requires.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our Solutions Architecture team empowers innovators to invent on behalf of customers. We are obsessed with understanding each customer's unique objectives to deliver optimal architectures tailored to their needs. Our culture celebrates talented, curious, motivated team members who take ownership of projects. We move with urgency, take risks, learn continuously, and maintain a friendly, inclusive environment. Join our team if you are passionate about technology and delighting customers.
   

  

 Your direct team is located across the Nordics and you would work in close collaboration with team members in Sweden and across borders.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship & Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**About Justera Group**  

Justera Group AB is a leading Swedish IT consulting firm with great experience specializing in building high-performing technology teams and delivering end-to-end IT solutions. Led by dynamic female executives, Justera Group focuses on helping businesses harness the power of digital technologies to continuously evolve in today’s rapidly changing economy. **About the Role:**  

We are looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer to join a team responsible for the development, operation, and security of platforms supporting critical applications.


In this role, you will work in an environment where stability, security, availability, and scalability are essential. You will collaborate closely with developers, architects, and security specialists to build and maintain robust platform solutions and efficient software delivery processes.

* Collaborate with development teams to improve and streamline software delivery processes.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**Vill du bygga plattformarna bakom några av Sveriges mest samhällsviktiga digitala tjänster?**  

  

Vi söker en Senior Platform Engineer som vill vara med och utveckla vår gemensamma plattform för containerbaserade lösningar. Plattformen är en central byggsten för våra produkter och tjänster och skapar förutsättningar för säker, skalbar och effektiv utveckling av lösningar som stödjer samhällskritiska verksamheter.  

  

Du blir en del av ett nytt team inom vår Shared Service Organisation där du får ett stort tekniskt ansvar och möjlighet att påverka plattformens utveckling, arkitektur och arbetssätt.
  

  

**Placering är möjlig på något av våra 30 kontor i Sverige.**

**Your future duties and responsibilities**


Som Senior Platform Engineer utvecklar och förvaltar du vår plattform tillsammans med ett erfaret team. Du arbetar nära utvecklingsteam, arkitekter och andra tekniska specialister för att skapa gemensamma plattformstjänster som förenklar utveckling, automatiserar leveranser och säkerställer en stabil, säker och skalbar plattform.  

  

I dina arbetsuppgifter ingår bland annat att:  

* Vidareutveckla och förvalta vår containerplattform samt plattformstjänster och CI/CD-flöden.
* Automatisera plattform och infrastruktur med Infrastructure as Code och GitOps.
* Arbeta med Kubernetes och containerbaserade plattformar.
* Integrera DevSecOps-principer i plattform och leveransflöden.
* Optimera plattformens prestanda, tillgänglighet och skalbarhet.
* Utveckla script, integrationer och interna verktyg, exempelvis i Python.
* Identifiera möjligheter att använda AI för att effektivisera utveckling, drift och plattformsförvaltning.
* Bidra till den långsiktiga utvecklingen av plattformens arkitektur och arbetssätt.
**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**


Vi ser gärna att du har:  

* Flerårig erfarenhet av Platform Engineering, DevOps eller systemutveckling.
* Praktisk erfarenhet av Kubernetes och containerbaserade plattformar.
* Erfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code, GitOps och automatisering.
* Erfarenhet av CI/CD och DevSecOps.
* Erfarenhet av scripting eller utveckling i exempelvis Python eller liknande språk.
* Intresse för AI-stödda verktyg och hur de kan användas för att effektivisera utveckling, drift och plattformsförvaltning.
* God samarbetsförmåga och vana att arbeta nära utvecklare, arkitekter och andra tekniska specialister.
* Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska

  

På grund av rollens utformning är svenskt medborgarskap ett krav.  

  

Meriterande  

* Erfarenhet av containerplattformar i större miljöer.
* Erfarenhet av publika eller privata molnplattformar.
* Erfarenhet av observability, monitorering och logghantering.
* Erfarenhet av moderna plattforms- och automationsverktyg.
* Erfarenhet av arbete i komplexa enterprise-miljöer och samhällskritiska verksamheter.

  

Som en del av rekryteringsprocessen genomförs bakgrundskontroll i form av kredit- och registerkontroll. Godkänd kontroll krävs för anställning.  

  

**Vad kan vi på CGI erbjuda dig?**  

CGIs kombination av global och lokal närvaro, med kontor på 30 orter i Sverige, ger nöjda kunder men innebär även att du som anställd alltid har ett kontor nära dig. Detta i kombination med flexibla arbetstider ger dig möjlighet till balans mellan privatliv och arbete, oavsett var i livet just du befinner dig.
  

  

På CGI finns även stora möjligheter till interna karriärvägar där du kan välja att bli specialist inom ditt område, bredda dig inom nya områden eller ta en ledande befattning.
  

  

Som anställd erbjuds du nedan förmåner:  

  

✅ Föräldralön: Vi betalar upp till cirka 90% av din lön under den första tiden hemma.  

✅ Aktieprogram och delägarskap: Som delägare har du möjlighet att påverka och i vårt aktieprogram matchar CGI ditt bidrag, krona för krona upp till 3% av din månadslön.  

✅Friskvårdsbidrag: Vi erbjuder ett årligt friskvårdsbidrag på 4000 kr.  

✅Trygg anställning: Våra medlemmar anställs med kollektivavtal och försäkringar.  

✅Pensionslösningar: Vi erbjuder attraktiva och förmånliga pensionslösningar.  

✅Personalbil: Personalbilen används som en privatbil men leasas av CGI.  

  

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! Om du har några frågor eller funderingar kontakta gärna mig Hubertus Von Fluck som är rekryterande chef för denna roll l hubertus.von.fluck@cgi.com  

  

Just nu är många av oss på semester och det kan därför dröja med återkoppling på din ansökan. Vi ber om tålamod och kommer att återkomma så snart som möjligt efter semesterperioden Tack för din förståelse.  

  

#LI-MN98**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**  

  

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…  

  

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.  

  

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.  

  

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
  

  

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.  

  

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

title: Senior Platform Engineer (Databricks)
description:
ALTEN Sweden is looking for a Senior Platform Engineer with strong expertise in Databricks, cloud platforms, and modern data engineering to join an exciting long-term assignment. You will be part of a highly skilled team developing and maintaining data platforms and pipelines that enable large-scale analytics, data science, and machine learning initiatives.


This role combines platform engineering, data engineering, cloud technologies, and data governance in a modern and data-driven environment.

  

About the role


As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will:


* Design, develop, and maintain scalable data platforms and data pipelines with a strong focus on Databricks.
* Drive improvements to platform architecture, setup, and capabilities.
* Develop and maintain robust ETL and data pipelines for large-scale operational data.
* Design and implement data governance models, metadata management solutions, and data catalog capabilities.
* Ensure high standards for data quality, security, compliance, and data discoverability.
* Implement and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions for Databricks and cloud environments.
* Build automated, reliable, and reproducible platform environments.
* Collaborate with developers, Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, and business stakeholders.
* Translate technical and business requirements into scalable and production-ready data solutions.
* Contribute to the continuous development, operation, and maintenance of the data platform.
Who You Are


We are looking for someone with:


* Several years of experience as a Data Engineer, Platform Engineer, or a similar senior role.
* Strong hands-on experience with Databricks and Apache Spark.
* Experience working with cloud-based data platforms, preferably AWS.
* Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.
* Experience designing, developing, and maintaining ETL and data pipelines.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar tools).
* Strong understanding of data governance, metadata management, data quality, and data discoverability.
* Experience building scalable, robust, and secure data platform solutions.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Fluent English, both written and spoken.
  

Meritorious


* AWS certifications.
* Databricks certifications.
* Experience with Unity Catalog and Delta Lake.
* Experience working in large-scale enterprise environments.
* Knowledge of DevOps and CI/CD practices.

ALTEN is one of Europe’s largest consulting companies within Engineering, IT and Life Sciences with over 54,000 employees in more than 30 countries. Vi söker dig som trivs i gränslandet mellan teknik, samarbete och koordinering. Som person är du kommunikativ, lyhörd och prestigelös. Du motiveras av att skapa struktur, hjälpa team att prestera på topp och driva förbättringar snarare än att ha ett formellt personalansvar.


Vi tror du har:

* Erfarenhet som senior utvecklare inom DevOps, Software Factory eller liknande teknisk miljö
* Erfarenhet av verktyg som Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub, Kubernetes, Helm, Grafana och Atlassian suite
* Tidigare erfarenhet som Scrum Master, Agile Coach, Team Lead eller teknisk koordinator i komplexa leveranser

### **Vad du blir en del av**


Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.


Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.


Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här

title: Data Engineer with DevSecOps focus | SEB, Stockholm Sweden, Hybrid
description:
SEB is more than a bank. We are a technology-driven financial institution where everything starts from our customer needs and business outcomes. AI, data and modern engineering are natural parts of how we work, build and deliver value. From core banking platforms to agentic AI , automation, cybersecurity and cloud, we offer a broad tech landscape and many paths to grow. Together, we are shaping secure, responsible and future- proof solutions for our customers and society. Are you ready to take on a new challenge?
   

  

**About the role:**
 In this role, you will own and operate the CI/CD platform that powers our GCP-based data warehouse making sure pipelines run reliably, securely, and in compliance with banking regulatory standards. You are the person who keeps builds green, deployments predictable, and the developer experience smooth, while ensuring our practices meet what's expected of a regulated financial institution.
   

  

 You work embedded in a data engineering team that is integrating data sources into a modern data warehouse. Your mission is to make sure the machinery that builds, tests, and deploys this platform works well and that we can demonstrate to auditors that it does. You'll drive pipeline reliability, harden supply-chain security, maintain governance documentation, manage incident response processes, and be the team's champion when something breaks or when auditors come knocking.
   

  

 You will share responsibility with other team members for day-to-day data engineering work, but your primary focus is health, security, and compliance of our build and delivery infrastructure.
   

  

**To thrive in this role, we believe you have:**
*DevSecOps & CI/CD (core)*
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Cloud Build, or similar)
* Hands-on with pipeline hardening: dependency pinning, container image scanning, vulnerability gating
* Familiarity with supply-chain security practices (SBOM, signed artifacts, immutable references)
* Experience with vulnerability scanning tools (e.g. Trivy, Snyk, or similar) integrated into build pipelines
* Understanding of IAM, least-privilege principles, and service account governance in cloud environments
* Track record of improving pipeline reliability, build times, and developer experience
* Experience responding to and learning from incidents (post-mortems, remediation tracking)
* Experience using LLMs as part of your development workflow, either professionally or through personal projects


*Considered meritorious skills:*
* Familiarity with GCP services (BigQuery, Composer/Airflow, Dataform) or similar cloud data platforms
* Comfortable reading and writing SQL and Python
* Understanding of data modelling concepts, lineage, and data quality
* Experience with ELT pipelines or data integration, enough to understand what you're securing
* Experience working in a regulated environment (banking/finance preferred)
* Knowledge of IT audit processes and ability to produce evidence for internal/external auditors
* Familiarity with incident management frameworks (ITIL-based or equivalent)
* Ability to author and maintain operational procedures, security guidelines, and compliance documentation


**What we offer:**
* Hybrid work model, meaning remote work is possible up to 2 days/week
* Long-term stability and growth as a company
* A diverse, inclusive and equal environment
* Entrepreneurial Scandinavian environment
* Opportunity to build connections with a top-level customer network


**Do you want to be part of SEB?**
 It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial to our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.  **31/8, 2026** 
 . If you have questions about the position, please contact Thanh Truong, thanh.truong@seb.se, note that we will not process applications via email.
   

  

 Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and history of crime. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks. During employment, employees within SEB can also expect to undergo recurring background checks.
