title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Vår kund är en av Sveriges ledande aktörer inom bank- och finansbranschen och befinner sig i en spännande teknisk förändringsresa. Nu bygger man vidare på en modern containerplattform och söker en senior Platform Engineer som vill ta en ledande teknisk roll i utvecklingen framåt.
   

  

 Det här är en möjlighet för dig som har gedigen erfarenhet av Kubernetes, Linux, automation, CI/CD och cloud native-teknologier – men som också har något mer.
   

  

 Du vill leda. Du vill påverka. Du vill utveckla både teknik och människor.
   

  

 Du blir en av de personer som sätter riktningen för hur plattformen ska utvecklas, samtidigt som du arbetar hands-on med tekniken.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som Lead Platform Engineer blir du en central del av plattformsteamet och får en viktig roll i att utveckla nästa generations containerplattform.
   

  

 Plattformen drivs idag on-prem, samtidigt som organisationen utforskar möjligheterna i molnet. Du kommer därför in i ett läge där mycket fortfarande är möjligt att påverka – från tekniska vägval och arkitektur till arbetssätt, automation och hur plattformen bäst möter utvecklingsteamen.
   

  

 Det här är inte rollen för dig som vill sitta och förvalta en färdig lösning.
   

  

 Vi söker dig som vill förstå problemen, utmana befintliga arbetssätt och tillsammans med teamet bygga något bättre.
   

  

 Du kommer att arbeta nära utveckling, drift och säkerhet och bli en viktig teknisk kraft i organisationens fortsatta modernisering.
   

  

**Du kommer bland annat att**
* Designa, utveckla och vidareutveckla containerbaserade plattformar on-prem och i cloud
* Arbeta med Kubernetes och moderna cloud native-teknologier
* Bygga och vidareutveckla CI/CD-flöden enligt GitOps-principer
* Automatisera drifts- och utvecklingsprocesser med exempelvis Ansible
* Arbeta med GitLab, ArgoCD och JFrog
* Driva tekniska förbättringar och bidra till arkitektur- och teknikval
* Identifiera nya möjligheter inom cloud native- och CNCF-ekosystemet
* Samarbeta nära utvecklingsteam för att skapa en plattform som är enkel, stabil och effektiv att använda
* Delta i incidenthantering och kontinuerligt förbättringsarbete
* Vara en teknisk förebild och bidra till att utveckla andra i teamet


**Vi söker en teknisk ledare – inte bara en senior utvecklare**
 Vi tror att du har flera års erfarenhet av Platform Engineering, DevOps eller motsvarande och är riktigt trygg i Kubernetes, Linux, automation och CI/CD.
   

  

 Du har sannolikt arbetat i komplexa tekniska miljöer och har erfarenhet av att bygga, utveckla eller modernisera plattformar.
   

  

 Men framför allt söker vi dig som har tagit ett naturligt tekniskt ledarskap i tidigare roller.
   

  

**Kanske Har Du**
* varit teknisk lead eller haft ett informellt tekniskt ledaransvar
* agerat mentor och bollplank för mindre erfarna kollegor
* drivit tekniska initiativ eller förändringsprojekt
* varit den som andra vänder sig till när komplexa tekniska problem ska lösas
* påverkat arkitektur, teknikval eller arbetssätt
* drivit förändring snarare än bara implementerat beslut som redan är fattade


 Rollen är inte för dig som söker en traditionell chefsroll, utan för dig som vill ta ett naturligt tekniskt ledarskap genom ansvar, kompetens och engagemang.
   

  

**Teknisk miljö**
* Kubernetes
* Linux
* GitLab
* ArgoCD
* JFrog
* Ansible
* GitOps
* Open source / CNCF-ekosystemet
* Java-baserade applikationer


**Det här får du**
 Här får du möjligheten att kliva in i en strategiskt viktig teknisk satsning hos en av Sveriges ledande aktörer inom bank- och finansbranschen.
   

  

 Du får vara med och påverka en plattform som är central för verksamheten – från tekniska vägval och arkitektur till arbetssätt och framtida molnresa.
   

  

 Du får arbeta med modern teknik, tillsammans med mycket kompetenta kollegor, och framför allt möjligheten att sätta din prägel på hur plattformen ska utvecklas framåt.
   

  

 Det här är en roll för dig som vill ta nästa steg – från att vara en riktigt duktig tekniker till att bli en teknisk drivkraft i en större förändringsresa.
   

  

 Tjänsten gäller en långsiktig anställning hos kunden.
   

  

**Är du vår nästa tekniska drivkraft?**
 Om du känner igen dig och vill vara med och bygga något som kommer att ha betydelse på riktigt – då vill vi gärna komma i kontakt med dig.
   

  

 Skicka in din ansökan så berättar vi mer om rollen, teamet och den tekniska resa som väntar.

title: Senior Azure Infrastructure Engineer

 Stockholm (primarily onsite)

 Permanent

title: Virtualiseringstekniker – Private Cloud & VMware
description:
Vill du vara med och bygga framtidens privata moln – och utvecklas som tekniker? Skatteverket befinner sig i en unik expansionsfas där vi inte bara utvecklar vår egen IT – vi bygger och levererar infrastrukturtjänster till flera myndigheter i Sverige. Just nu utvecklar vi nästa generations privata molnplattform, samtidigt som vi etablerar en AI‑verkstad för både intern och extern användning. Det här är en miljö där du får möjlighet att både lära dig snabbt och jobba med modern teknik i stor skala. Upptäck ett mångsidigt uppdrag!
   

  

**Om jobbet**
 Du blir en del av avdelningen Skatteverkets tekniska tjänster (STT) med cirka 500 medarbetare. Du ingår i ett team inom server, virtualisering och lagring som ansvarar för vår IaaS‑plattform.
   

  

 Som tekniker får du arbeta nära erfarna kollegor och successivt bygga upp din kompetens inom virtualisering. Du arbetar med drift, förvaltning och vidareutveckling av vår virtualiseringsplattform i en komplex It-miljö. Du samarbetar med andra teknikområden som nätverk, lagring och plattform och tillsammans bidrar ni till förbättringar och automatisering av arbetssätt. Dessutom är du med och utvecklar vår privata molnplattform.
   

  

 Hos oss får du möjlighet att lära dig av erfarna specialister inom virtualisering och cloud och möjlighet att arbeta med teknik som ligger nära private cloud, automation och containerplattformar. Utöver spännande tekniska möjligheter erbjuder vi en god balans mellan arbete.
   

  

 Skatteverkets it-avdelning arbetar aktivt för att främja en inkluderande arbetsplats som präglas av jämställdhet och mångfald där alla medarbetare får lika möjligheter att bidra och utvecklas. Läs mer på Jobba med it hos oss
   

  

 Du kommer att ha placeringsort Malmö eller Sundbyberg.
   

  

**Om dig**
 För att göra ett bra jobb och trivas hos oss på Skatteverket behöver du vara lyhörd, tänka nytt och ta ansvar. I arbetet är gott omdöme och förståelse för rättssäkerhet och säkerhet viktigt. Du ska också leva upp till vår medarbetarpolicy.
   

  

**I Det Här Jobbet Ska Du**
* ha god samarbetsförmåga, vara hjälpsam och ha ett gott bemötande
* ha förmågan och viljan att lära dig nya saker, vara flexibel och öppen för förändringar
* ta initiativ, tänka nytt och ta ställning i frågor
* självständigt planera och driva ditt arbete framåt för att nå resultat
* uttrycka dig väl i tal och skrift på svenska


**Du Ska Även Ha**
* något års aktuell och relevant arbetslivserfarenhet virtualisering
* arbetslivserfarenhet inom nätverk (routing och switching)
* relevant erfarenhet av containerteknik


 Det är önskvärt om du har erfarenhet VCF och Infrastructure as Code. Automation är även önskvärt.
   

  

**Bra att veta**
 Anställningen är tillsvidare och kan inledas med provanställning i sex månader.
   

  

 En anställning hos oss kan innebära placering i säkerhetsklass. En säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) kan därför komma att genomföras före beslut om anställning. För en del av våra arbetsuppgifter i säkerhetsklass krävs svenskt medborgarskap.
   

  

 På skatteverket.se/jobb kan du exempelvis läsa om vår samhällsbärande roll, fördelarna med att jobba hos oss och hur det går till när du söker våra jobb.
   

  

 När du ansöker bifogar du ditt cv. Vi använder inte personligt brev i våra rekryteringar och du ska därför inte bifoga det i din ansökan.
   

  

 Ansvariga kontaktpersoner har begränsad tillgänglighet under semesterperioden. Om du önskar komma i kontakt med någon av oss, maila oss gärna så hjälper vi dig vidare. Intervjuer planeras att genomföras under vecka 36 och 37.
   

  

 Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Senior Platform Engineer (Databricks)
description:
ALTEN Sweden is looking for a
 **Senior Platform Engineer** 
 with strong expertise in
 **Databricks, cloud platforms, and modern data engineering** 
 to join an exciting long-term assignment. You will be part of a highly skilled team developing and maintaining data platforms and pipelines that enable large-scale analytics, data science, and machine learning initiatives.
 



 This role combines platform engineering, data engineering, cloud technologies, and data governance in a modern and data-driven environment.
 



  





**About the role** 




 As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will:
 


* Design, develop, and maintain scalable data platforms and data pipelines with a strong focus on Databricks.
* Drive improvements to platform architecture, setup, and capabilities.
* Develop and maintain robust ETL and data pipelines for large-scale operational data.
* Design and implement data governance models, metadata management solutions, and data catalog capabilities.
* Ensure high standards for data quality, security, compliance, and data discoverability.
* Implement and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions for Databricks and cloud environments.
* Build automated, reliable, and reproducible platform environments.
* Collaborate with developers, Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, and business stakeholders.
* Translate technical and business requirements into scalable and production-ready data solutions.
* Contribute to the continuous development, operation, and maintenance of the data platform.



  





**Who You Are** 




 We are looking for someone with:
 


* Several years of experience as a Data Engineer, Platform Engineer, or a similar senior role.
* Strong hands-on experience with Databricks and Apache Spark.
* Experience working with cloud-based data platforms, preferably AWS.
* Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.
* Experience designing, developing, and maintaining ETL and data pipelines.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar tools).
* Strong understanding of data governance, metadata management, data quality, and data discoverability.
* Experience building scalable, robust, and secure data platform solutions.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Fluent English, both written and spoken.



  





**Meritorious** 



* AWS certifications.
* Databricks certifications.
* Experience with Unity Catalog and Delta Lake.
* Experience working in large-scale enterprise environments.
* Knowledge of DevOps and CI/CD practices.



  





**What we offer you** 




 Every employee is equally valuable in the success of ALTEN! We believe in growing together by offering opportunities, development and togetherness. ALTEN operates in several different industries, having a wide variety of assignments, coaching managers and training through ALTEN Academy, which means that it will always be possible to develop at ALTEN. Your wishes will guide your way forward.
 



  





 As a consultant, you will get the genuine team feeling at your assignment but also a wonderful togetherness at ALTEN. Through our different internal networks, such as Women@ALTEN and ALTEN Sports you will get the opportunity to drive topics and activities that are close to your heart. At ALTEN, we think it's important to have a balance between work and spare time, which is why we offer three extra days off a year. We have a collective agreement and offer benefits like pension, insurances and wellness grants.
 



  





  





**About ALTEN** 




 ALTEN is one of Europe’s largest technology and IT consulting companies with over 57,000 employees in nearly 30 countries. Our engineers carry out complex and highly technical projects throughout the value chain of the most prestigious companies in all sectors, such as Automotive, Defense, Energy & Environment, Industry, Public services & Government and Life Sciences. In Sweden, we are about 1300 committed employees with 9 offices in 9 cities - from Lund in the south to Skellefteå in the north.
 



  





 For the fifth year in a row, ALTEN has been named one of Sweden's most attractive employers by Karriärföretagen, an award for employers that offer unique career and development opportunities.
 



  





 Welcome to read more about us at alten.se

title: Tech Lead – AI
description:
Vill du leda arbetet med att höja Svenska kraftnäts AI-förmåga och göra våra mest lovande AI-lösningar till stabila och säkra lösningar som driver den svenska energiomställningen framåt?
   

  

 Svenska kraftnät är en nyckelaktör i energiomställningen. Vår IT-division på Svenska kraftnät växer för att möjliggöra en fördubblad elproduktion och en fossilfri framtid. Med ny teknik ökar vi både infrastrukturens kapacitet och utvecklingstakten inom digitalisering och processer. För att få upp tempot i utvecklingen har vi etablerat ett innovationslabb. Här bygger och testar vi nya lösningar och omsätter AI i konkret nytta för hela organisationen.
   

  

 Till vårt innovationslabb söker vi nu en tech lead som ska leda arbetet med att skala upp och industrialisera AI-lösningar inom organisationen.
   

  

**Om tjänsten**
 I rollen samarbetar du med seniora tech leads för att omvandla prototyper till produktionsklara lösningar och säkerställa att de uppfyller höga tekniska och säkerhetsmässiga krav. Mycket av arbetet sker i teknikens framkant och med AI som central komponent – både som utvecklingsverktyg och del av lösningen.
   

  

**Exempel på arbetsuppgifter**
* Utveckla AI-prototyper till färdiga produkter på ett skalbart sätt
* Sätta ramar och instruktioner för AI-agenter med syfte att automatisera och effektivisera utvecklingsarbetet
* Genomföra kod- och arkitekturgranskning för att identifiera förbättringsområden
* Säkerställa att tekniska och säkerhetsmässiga krav uppfylls
* Driva strategiskt och operativt arbete för att öka AI-förmågan och sprida AI-användning inom IT-organisationen


 AI-området utvecklas i mycket snabb takt. Du förväntas inte vara expert från start, utan får möjlighet att utveckla din kompetens löpande genom det dagliga arbetet samt via kurser, workshops och konferenser. Du kommer också att kunna utvecklas inom framtidens energiteknik hos den centrala spelaren i Sverige för energiomställningen.
   

  

**Om dig**
**Skallkrav:**
 Vi söker dig som är framåtlutad, analytisk och har förmågan att se helheten samtidigt som du kan bryta ned komplexa frågor i tydliga delar. Du är övertygande och kan bygga förtroende genom tydlig kommunikation och väl underbyggda resonemang. Du har god samarbetsförmåga och trivs med att skapa samsyn tillsammans med andra. Som person är du strukturerad och bidrar till ordning och riktning i komplexa sammanhang.
   

  

 Du ska också leva upp till den statliga värdegrunden. I denna rekrytering lägger vi stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.
   

  

 Vidare har du en akademisk examen från högskola eller universitet, alternativt motsvarande kompetens förvärvad på annat sätt. Du har även:
   

  

* Mycket god programmeringskunskap (flerårig arbetslivserfarenhet som utvecklare)
* Flerårig erfarenhet av att arbeta som teknisk ledare/arkitekt i utvecklingsprojekt
* Flerårig erfarenhet från att arbeta i större organisationer med modernt utvecklingsarbete
* Djupgående, praktisk erfarenhet av agentbaserad AI för mjukvaruutveckling
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska


 Vi ser det som
 **meriterande** 
 om du har:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av egna AI-projekt eller initiativ som skapat konkret värde
* Erfarenhet av att bygga, driftsätta och förvalta AI-lösningar i miljöer med höga säkerhetskrav
* Bevisad förmåga att leda och implementera teknikskiften på en storskalig nivå
* Erfarenhet av att framgångsrikt tillgängliggöra och etablera AI i större verksamheter
* Praktisk erfarenhet av DevSecOps och automatiserade säkerhetskontroller i CI/CD-flöden
* Erfarenhet av arbete inom säkerhetskänslig verksamhet


**Bra att veta**
* Tjänsten är placerad i Sundbyberg
* Möjlighet till distansarbete upp till 50 %, om arbetet tillåter.
* Sista ansökningsdag är den 11 september 2026

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Skala upp din karriär inom Data Analytics!
 



 Har du en passion för datadrivna lösningar och en vilja att göra skillnad? Vi är ett innovativt konsultföretag inom Data Analytics som kombinerar ett team av erfarna experter och ett starkt europeiskt partnernätverk för att skapa mervärde för våra kunders befintliga och framtida lösningar inom Data Analytics.
 



 Vår filosofi bygger på att vara starkare tillsammans och vi är stolta över att erbjuda en miljö där det är tryggt att utmana sig själv och lära av misstag, det är lärande och utveckling som driver oss framåt.
 



  





**Varför Rebtech?** 



* Bli en del av ett erfaret team och arbeta med några av branschens
 **mest kompetenta experter** 
 inom Data Analytics. Hos oss står lärande och kunskapsutbyte i fokus!
* **Kultur som prioriterar gemenskap** 
 . Hos oss råder en prestigelös atmosfär där laget alltid går före jaget.
* **Förmåner utöver det vanliga** 
 . Marknadsmässig fast lön, bonus, möjlighet till delägarskap samt generös pensionsavsättning, friskvårdsbidrag och regelbundna teamaktiviteter gör att du både kan växa och trivas på jobbet.



  





**Data Engineer på Rebtech** 




 Som Data Engineer på rebtech har en central roll i att designa, bygga och underhålla kundernas dataplattformar och pipelines. Du vill arbeta brett och hantera hela leveranskedjan, från dataintegration till att skapa värdefulla insikter för kunderna. Rollen ger dig utrymme att vara innovativ och proaktiv i att möta kundernas specifika behov och utmaningar.
 



  





**Du besitter flera av följande egenskaper:** 




  




* Har fyra eller fler års erfarenhet inom Business Intelligence och Data Warehousing
* Har programmeringskunskaper i ett eller flera språk (Python, Scala, Java eller liknande)
* Har erfarenhet av bygga ETL/ELT-pipelines
* Har erfarenhet Azure och MS Fabric
* Van att arbeta med DevOps: GIT, CI/CD
* Har erfarenhet av containerteknologier och IaC (Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform eller liknande )
* Arbetat med moderna verktyg som Databricks, DBT, Power BI och Airflow
* Flytande kunskaper i svenska och engelska
* Relevant universitetsexamen



  





**Personliga egenskaper** 




 Du är en analytisk och lösningsorienterad person som trivs lika bra med att arbeta självständigt som i nära samarbete med ditt team. Med ett genuint driv att utforska och lära dig nya teknologier håller du dig ständigt uppdaterad och bidrar med nytänkande idéer. Du kommunicerar klart och tydligt, både muntligt och skriftligt, och skapar förtroende genom din förmåga att göra komplexa resonemang lättbegripliga.
 



  





**Vad vi erbjuder** 



* Möjlighet att arbeta med cutting-edge teknologi och spännande projekt.
* En arbetsmiljö som främjar kreativitet och innovation.
* Kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling och karriärmöjligheter.
* Flexibla arbetsvillkor och bra arbetslivsbalans.



  





**Ansökningsprocess** 




 Nyfiken? Även om du inte aktivt söker nytt arbete så välkomnar vi konfidentiella dialoger, hör av dig så berättar vi mer!
 



  





 I denna rekrytering samarbetar vi med Aliby - The Pink Company. Då intervjuer och urval sker löpande ber vi dig att inte vänta med din ansökan. Vid intresse vänligen kontakta ansvarig rekryteringskonsult Lars Ohlson på lars.ohlson@aliby.se eller +46 70 588 81 75
 



 Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: Solutions Architect, Software and Technology Companies (ISV)
description:
**Description**
 Are you passionate about cloud technology and helping customers innovate?
   

  

 Join our AWS Solutions Architecture team in Sweden and empower Software, SaaS and Technology Companies to innovate at speed and scale with cloud technologies.
   

  

 Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help them make the most of the Cloud. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with organizations at all stages of cloud adoption. Solutions Architects are responsible for creating and presenting technical content and sharing best practices.
   

  

 They work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. They help customer's validate their initiatives from ideation to proof of concept. Solutions Architects lead activities such as architecture reviews, white-boarding sessions, demos and technical workshops. They collaborate with other teams such as account management, professional services, Industry experts, support, service teams and the AWS partner ecosystem.
   

  

 Amongst others you will be part of the design and building of reference architectures, proof of concepts and help customer deploy production workloads on AWS. You will also provide thought leadership and recommendations on cloud architecture, migration, modernization and operation. Build strong technical relationships acting as the voice of the customer internally to influence AWS service roadmaps.
   

  

 At Amazon you will be encouraged and rewarded for doing what is right for the long-term success of the customer. We value your passion to discover, invent and build on behalf of customers.
   

  

 Amazon has always been, and always will be, committed to diversity and inclusion. We seek builders from all backgrounds to join our teams, and we encourage our employees to bring their authentic, original, and best selves to work.
   

  

 AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and dedicated support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Work directly with strategic customers to accelerate their challenging, mission-critical projects and recommend best-practice architectures in line with their long-term business outcomes
* Build technical relationships with customers and operate as their trusted advisor. The best interests of the customer will shape the guidance you provide.
* Share the voice of the customer to inform the roadmap of AWS features.
* Participate in the creation and sharing of best practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts).
* Evangelise and educate customers about AWS technology (e.g. through workshops, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).
* Contribute to the growth of the Solutions Architecture organisation by interviewing candidates and having a voice in hiring decisions. You will also be helping others develop new skills by mentoring team members and identifying talent needs in the organisation.
* Develop areas of depth in technical domains relevant to our outcomes.


 A day in the life
   

  

 You will have the opportunity to work with account managers to help customers accelerate their cloud implementation to modernize their business on AWS. Working with these customers, you will help them transform existing workloads by designing modern target architectures optimized for business agility, innovation, performance, resiliency, cost, security, and more using both native and partner solutions.
   

  

 Our teams focus on understanding customer key business drivers as well as the existing application architecture(s) to deliver a technical recommendation to the customer with a goal of designing a robust cloud architecture that can scale as their business requires.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our Solutions Architecture team empowers innovators to invent on behalf of customers. We are obsessed with understanding each customer's unique objectives to deliver optimal architectures tailored to their needs. Our culture celebrates talented, curious, motivated team members who take ownership of projects. We move with urgency, take risks, learn continuously, and maintain a friendly, inclusive environment. Join our team if you are passionate about technology and delighting customers.
   

  

 Your direct team is located across the Nordics and you would work in close collaboration with team members in Sweden and across borders.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship & Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Background in any of the following: Cloud Architecture, Systems Design, Software Development, Infrastructure Architecture, or DevOps
* Technical Degree (Computer Science, Maths, Engineering or equivalent) and/or relevant tech experience.
* Fluent written and verbal communication skills in English
* A passion for technology and for learning


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience designing, building, refactoring or operating IT systems in the cloud
* Working knowledge of software development practices and technologies highly desired
* AWS Certification, eg. AWS Solutions Architect Associate


 Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.
   

  

 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:
**About Us**

**nShift** is the leading global provider of cloud delivery management solutions (SaaS), we enable the frictionless shipment and return of almost one billion shipments across 190 countries each year. We are headquartered in London and Oslo and have over 500 employees across offices in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, Belgium, and Romania.


Our software is used by many of the world leading e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, and 3PL shippers due to us having over 1000 carriers integrated into our platform, nearly 3 times more than our competitors!

  

If you buy goods online, there is a strong chance that nShift has powered that delivery, so come and join us as we shape the future of shipping, one frictionless journey at a time.

**Purpose of Role**


nShift is a forward-thinking SaaS technology company specialising in delivery management software for ecommerce, retail and manufacturing. We are dedicated to innovation and excellence and are looking for a Head of Regional Marketing to lead growth across the Nordics on a fixed-term maternity cover basis (one-year contract).


This is an experienced, commercially focused role responsible for driving new ARR growth through marketing-generated pipeline, accelerating customer expansion and strengthening nShift’s market presence.


You will work in close alignment with regional sales and partner stakeholders and collaborate across marketing disciplines to translate company strategy into high-performing regional programmes that deliver measurable revenue impact.

**What you'll be doing**

* Lead regional demand generation to drive marketing-generated leads, pipeline and new ARR growth, alongside customer expansion.
* Activate a strong mix of channels including events, webinars, local email campaigns, content localization, PR and digital campaigns to support regional growth priorities.
* Act as the primary marketing lead for regional sales and partner stakeholders, ensuring strong alignment on go-to-market priorities and revenue targets.
* Co-create regional plans that support both direct and partner-influenced growth.
* Own the regional events strategy, from flagship field events to executive roundtables and partner-led activation ensuring clear pipeline and expansion impact.
* Take accountability for funnel progression of marketing-generated leads, ensuring effective follow-through from first touch to opportunity and close.
* Build and scale regional customer advocacy, including customer stories, case studies and speaking opportunities.
* Collaborate closely with marketing teams across growth, website, brand and creative, social media and product marketing to ensure regional needs shape priorities and execution.
* Bring regional market insight into company planning, helping shape messaging, campaigns and go-to-market strategy.

**About you**


As Head of Regional Marketing – Nordics at nShift, you will play a pivotal role in maintaining momentum and shaping how the business grows across the Nordic markets during this maternity cover period. You combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, bringing strong commercial acumen and a passion for building market impact through aligned, high-performing teams.


You are comfortable operating in a fast-moving, matrixed organisation and thrive on turning regional insight into tangible revenue results.

**What you will bring**

* Proven experience leading regional or field marketing in a B2B SaaS or technology environment.
* Strong track record in demand generation, events and customer marketing, with evidence of driving marketing-sourced pipeline, new ARR and expansion.
* Experience working closely with sales and partner stakeholders in a revenue-focused environment.
* Deep understanding of funnel performance and the end-to-end lead lifecycle.
* Ability to translate company strategy into locally relevant, high-impact execution.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to influence across functions and geographies.
* Comfortable working across enterprise and mid-market segments.

**Kindly ensure that your CV is submitted in English.**

At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

-------------------

You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing the organization’s network infrastructure, ensuring it is robust, scalable, and aligned with business goals.

* Leading the design and implementation of Network infrastructures, including LAN, WAN, VPNs, cloud networks, and SD-WAN.
* Collaborating with IT and business stakeholders to understand requirements and develop a long-term strategic roadmap for Network architecture.

As part of our recruitment process, identity verification or background checks may occasionally be conducted.

title: Finance Data, Reporting & AI Expert (ERP Transformation) - Contractor
description:

**About the role:**

As the **Finance Data, Reporting & AI Expert (ERP Transformation)**, you'll own the finance data architecture underpinning our NetSuite ERP transformation - from chart of accounts design and data governance through to the group management reporting suite, consolidation model and Board level KPI analytics framework. **Reporting & Analytics**

**AI & Automation**

* Identify, evaluate and implement AI/ML tools relevant to finance operations and reporting
* Partner with IT and vendors to build scalable, production-grade automation pipelines integrated with NetSuite
* Build the business case and roadmap for AI adoption in finance - including ROI modelling and change planning

**Programme & Stakeholder Leadership**

* Collaborate with external SI partners on NetSuite data configuration, SuiteAnalytics and API integration design

* Experience working with high reporting standards and investor scrutiny

**Why you should join myPOS:**

title: Case Study & Content Arbetspraktik
description:

**We're Looking For Someone Who**

* Is organised, proactive, and comfortable following up with different stakeholders

title: Bachelor and master’s thesis degree project
description:
Orange Cyberdefense is Sweden’s leading cybersecurity company. We are seeking students for multiple research projects in a wide range of topics. Both Bachelor and Master-level students are welcome to apply. You are welcome to conduct your project either alone or in pairs or groups of students. Our three main areas of interest are:

* Cybersecurity, information security, and related topics
* Management, organization, and ethics
* Artificial intelligence

**We have identified some initial research suggestions within these areas. However, we leave it up to the students themselves to choose and propose the specific research question to explore within these areas.**

**Cybersecurity, information security, and related topics**
-----------------------------------------------------------


Cybersecurity and information security sits at the core of our business. As such, these topics are particularly salient for us at Orange Cyberdefense – and we are eager to enable research in this field. Some of our initial research suggestions include:

* Analyze the relationship between different regulatory frameworks in relation to a security issue. For example, how current EU legislation affects third-party risk management.
* How employee awareness and security training influence susceptibility to phishing and social-engineering attacks.
* Cybersecurity risk in cloud environments. For example, examine common security risks associated with cloud services and how organizations can mitigate them.

**Management, organization, and ethics**
----------------------------------------


Orange Cyberdefense is an international company with 400 employees in Sweden and 3000 colleagues across the globe. As such, we are happy to enable research on management and organizational topics. A global research angle is also possible here. Research suggestions include:

* Studying organizational cultures, strategies, and characteristics of different Orange Cyberdefense business units in different countries. Possibly in terms of AI usage.
* Comparing our management strategies with those of other cybersecurity companies.
* Customer excellence research project which analyses customer needs in relation to the services provided by Orange Cyberdefense.
* Analysis of relevant regulatory, financial, organizational, technical and logistical characteristics which face different customers in different sectors.

**Artificial intelligence**
---------------------------


Artificial intelligence is a key area of interest for us. We are very eager to proceed with a wide range of research projects on this topic. Some of our initial suggestions include:

* AI in phishing detection. Such as how phishing detection using linguistic and behavioral features compare to traditional classifiers.
* How attackers can manipulate inputs to evade AI-based intrusion detection systems.
* How large language models can identify and explain vulnerabilities.

**Applying for a research project**
-----------------------------------


Please apply by the ad. If you have more than one research idea, please include them all in one application. Make sure that your application reflects the following requirements:

* Include a short description of your proposed research, your area of interest, and clear suggestions for specific research question(s). It should be clear what you are interested in researching.
* Include initial suggestions for data collection- and analysis methods. Most importantly, describe what kind of data your project might need and from where you expect to collect it.
* Includes the full names of the participating student(s), what university you study at, if you are a bachelor or master’s student, and the approximate date your university expects you to start writing the thesis.
* The proposal does not exceed 1 page (or roughly 500 words) in length. If you want to propose **more than one** research idea, you may exceed this limit. However, please keep the length reasonably short.
* Make sure that everything is written directly in the email. **Do not** append your research proposal in a PDF or similar. Instead, write your text in the email itself.
* The subject/title of your email must begin with “Student Research Proposal:”, followed by the name of your project. Example: “*Student Research Proposal: Strategies for ethical AI use”*

**What if I want to propose an entirely new research idea?**
------------------------------------------------------------


You do not have to base your research proposal on our existing research suggestions. We are very happy to receive your very own research idea. If you want to put forward your own project proposal, please follow the steps listed above.

**Requirements and information about the research opportunity**
---------------------------------------------------------------


Your profile and the specific skills required will vary greatly depending on the nature of your research project. However, all candidates must live up to the following requirements.

* You are a bachelor or master’s student enrolled in a program at a Swedish University.
* You are fluent in English and Swedish.
* You are capable and willing to take the initiative and drive your research project forward.


Students are assigned to a research mentor at Orange Cyberdefense. Your mentor will help you define your research project, check in with you at regular intervals, and act as your go-between for reaching resources and employees within Orange Cyberdefense. Please note that students will not be able to conduct research projects that involve data from our clients. Due to the sensitive nature of Orange Cyberdefenses business, students will not be able to fully carry out their projects on-premise. At the onset of your research project, you and other students writing their thesis at Orange Cyberdefense are invited to our office for a kickoff meeting.


Rights and ownership over research results will belong to Orange Cyberdefense. As such, students are expected to sign a research project agreement before starting their project. Orange Cyberdefense does not provide monetary compensation for student research projects. However, we view these research projects as an organic way to get to know candidates for future roles.

**We are Orange Cyberdefense**
------------------------------


Orange Cyberdefense is Sweden’s leading cybersecurity company. Our vision is to help secure the digital society. We provide our customers with services across a wide range of areas, from advanced technical solutions to strategic services such as security governance, risk management frameworks, and risk assessments. We are 400 colleagues in Sweden and 3,000 colleagues globally.

title: Join our Architecture Lab!
description:
Join the Revolution in Commercial Vehicle Tech at Coretura!
  
Coretura exists to make commercial vehicles as easy to develop software for as a smartphone. One platform: hardware, software and connectivity unit, delivered to multiple vehicle OEMs and running in real programs.
  
We're now building our Architecture Lab in Lindholmen, Gothenburg. We're looking for architects across several areas.
  
What does the Architecture Lab do?
  
**The Architecture Lab owns the system as a whole:** how the parts fit together, what the interfaces and contracts between them are, and how the platform holds up as one product across several customers and vehicle generations.
  
That means you set direction rather than detail out solutions. You define principles, allocation and guard rails, decide what belongs where, and make sure the safety, security and integration arguments hold across the whole system.
  
You stay close to the implementation, so your decisions are grounded in how the system actually behaves, and you bring the technical depth to build shared understanding with development teams, suppliers and vendors.
  
The areas we're hiring into
  
  

Vehicle. Fitting our compute products into each customer's E/E architecture, and turning different topologies into configurability instead of forks.
  
  

System safety. Safety concepts, allocation of safety requirements, and the argument that safety critical and non safety functions can share compute and networks.
  
  

Product security. Trust anchors and secure boot, isolation boundaries, cryptographic services, and threat analysis that changes the design.
  
  

**Infotainment. The cockpit domain:** compute, OS and hypervisor landscape, middleware and HMI, sharing hardware with safety relevant functions.
  
  

Communication. How signals and services move between compute nodes, and the determinism, bandwidth and latency budgets that make it hold.
  
  

**Connectivity. The vehicle's link to the world:** wireless connectivity, the gateway between external and internal networks, and the path to the cloud.
  
  

**ADAS. The sensor to reaction chain:** perception integration, workload mapping on accelerated compute, and real performance out of the silicon.
  
  

Power and network management. When compute wakes, boots, degrades and sleeps, and the energy budget that keeps a parked vehicle startable.
  
  

**System architecture modelling. How architecture is expressed:** the metamodel, the product structure, and the docs as code toolchain that keeps it traceable.
  
  

What you bring
  
You're an experienced software engineer who has grown into system architecture responsibility within your domain, and you're ready to take that scope across a whole platform. We're looking for T-shaped profiles: real depth in one of the areas above, and enough knowledge to understand how your decisions affect the other areas.
  
You enjoy working across team and supplier boundaries, and you know the regulatory frame the platform lives in well enough to design with it rather than around it. You have the judgement and credibility to make decisions and bring engineering teams, customers and suppliers along with them, and you like being the person who resolves the trade off.
  
Why Coretura?
  
At Coretura, you’ll be empowered to make a real impact. We value initiative, ownership, and a proactive mindset. You’ll have the freedom to drive projects forward, contribute ideas, and help shape the future of commercial vehicle technology. Our lean, innovative team is always learning and adapting—your contributions will truly matter.
  
Next steps Ready to build the future of commercial vehicles?
  
We review applications on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to submit yours!
  
**Last application date:** 1 of September.
  
Questions? Don’t hesitate to reach out to Tobias Schött, tobias.schott@coretura.com if you have any questions regarding the position.Please note we do not accept any applications via email.
  
About our recruitment process We are committed to a safe and secure working environment. As a mandatory part of our recruitment process, we carry out drug and alcohol testing and background checks via 2Secure on the final candidate. The background check covers personal details, financial information, company engagements, legal matters, CV verification, media and internet presence, as well as a risk analysis and recommendation.
  
A negative drug and alcohol test and an approved background check are required before a formal offer can be made. All checks are carried out in accordance with GDPR, and candidates are always informed in advance.

This means we will review your profile without knowing your identity, and keep the initial dialogue to an untraceable mail address.

title: LEAD MACHINE LEARNING OPS ENGINEER
description:
**City:** Solna
  
About the role
  
  

At SAS, machine learning has moved well beyond experimentation. As part of our ongoing Digital & IT transformation, we are expanding our investments in machine learning, automation, data platforms, MLOps, and Generative AI. We design, deploy, and operate production models that steer pricing decisions, personalize customer experiences, and make our operations smarter every day. Delivering business value from machine learning requires more than great models. It requires robust platforms, strong engineering practices, and operational excellence. As our Lead MLOps Engineer, you will be a thought leader who sets the standard for how machine learning is engineered and operated across SAS. You will shape the future of our ML platform, drive technical excellence, influence architecture and standards, and ensure our production ML ecosystem remains scalable, reliable, observable, and secure.
  
  

If you're ready to lead the next chapter of machine learning engineering at SAS, this is the role for you!
  
  

We are looking for a Lead MLOps Engineer to own the end-to-end ML lifecycle at SAS, from the way models are built and validated, through deployment and serving, to how they are monitored, maintained, and retrained in production. This is a thought leadership role as much as a hands-on engineering role.
  
  

You will help shape how AI is engineered and operated at scale within SAS, establishing the foundations that enable machine learning, Generative AI, and future AI capabilities to move efficiently from experimentation to production.
  
  

You will define what "production-ready" means for ML at SAS and make it a team-wide standard. You will work closely with data scientists to engineer models for operability from the start, collaborate with developers and operations roles to improve how model ops are structured and handed over, and partner with Data Engineering and IT to mature the underlying platform. You report to the Head of AI & Automation.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Define and own the MLOps vision and standards for the AI & Automation team, covering the full lifecycle from experiment to production to retraining.
  
**Establish what "production-ready" looks like for ML at SAS:** packaging, testing, documentation, monitoring hooks, and rollback procedures built in from the start.
  
Work directly with data scientists during model development to ensure models are designed for operability.
  
Design and improve the handover process between the in-house ML team and the offshore operations team, creating clarity, structure, and shared standards.
  
**Build and mature the MLOps platform on Azure:** model registry, CI/CD pipelines for ML, automated retraining, feature management, and deployment infrastructure.
  
Establish model monitoring and observability frameworks, defining what to track, how to alert, and how to act when model performance degrades.
  
Drive adoption of MLOps best practices across the team through documentation, templates, review processes, and active coaching.
  
Evaluate and introduce MLOps tooling and frameworks (MLflow, Azure ML, etc.) where they improve the team's ability to operate at scale.
  
Collaborate with Data Engineering and IT on infrastructure, security standards, and cost-efficient operation of the ML platform.
  
Contribute to the broader AI & Automation technical roadmap alongside the Head of AI & Automation and the Data & AI Architecture team.
  
The Team
  
  

We are a central AI & Automation function within SAS Digital & IT that develops and operates solutions across ML, MLOps, automation, and Generative AI. Our team of data scientists, AI engineers and ML engineers work together to deliver AI that creates real, measurable value.
  
  

As SAS continues to strengthen its AI capabilities, we are investing in modern cloud platforms, scalable AI solutions, engineering excellence, and AI-native ways of working that enable machine learning to create value across the business.
  
  

Today, model operations are largely handled by an offshore team. The ML team wants to evolve beyond that split, building a coherent end-to-end approach where production-readiness is built in from the start. This role exists to lead that shift.
  
  

You will be the senior MLOps voice in the team, setting the direction, establishing the standards, and working hands-on alongside data scientists and engineers to close the gap between model development and reliable production operations.
  
  

To be successful we believe you have
  
Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Machine Learning, Mathematics, or a related field.
  
At least 5 years of hands-on experience in ML engineering or MLOps, with a track record of owning production ML systems end-to-end.
  
**Deep expertise across the ML lifecycle:** experiment tracking, model packaging, CI/CD for ML, deployment and serving, monitoring, drift detection, and automated retraining.
  
Proven experience operating ML models in production on Azure (Azure ML, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent cloud platforms).
  
Strong proficiency in Python; experience with MLflow or similar tools.
  
Experience with containerisation and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) in a cloud environment.
  
Demonstrated ability to set technical standards and influence engineering practices across a team, without necessarily having formal line management responsibility.
  
Experience working with or alongside offshore or distributed engineering teams, including designing effective handover and collaboration processes.
  
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Terraform) on Azure.
  
Familiarity with AI-native SDLC practices and Coding Assistants is a plus.
  
Strong communication skills, able to translate MLOps complexity into clear direction for data scientists and into plain language for non-technical stakeholders.
  
Experience with LLM-based systems, agentic AI, or GenAI engineering patterns is a plus
  
  

We believe you are a pragmatic technical leader who combines deep MLOps expertise with a genuine interest in raising the capability of the team around you. You are hands-on enough to earn credibility, structured enough to define standards that stick, and collaborative enough to bring both the team along with you. You see production reliability not as a constraint on speed, but as what makes speed sustainable.
  
  

Why SAS?
  
  

Join SAS at an exciting time of technological transformation. Digital & IT is modernizing its technology landscape, strengthening cloud-native capabilities, and expanding the use of AI across the company. As Lead MLOps Engineer, you will play a key role in building the engineering foundations that enable AI solutions to scale across SAS, influencing platform strategy, engineering standards, and operational excellence.
  
  

At SAS, we offer extensive opportunities for professional development in an international, fast-paced working environment. We are dedicated to the continuous growth of our employees. Working with us comes with a variety of benefits, including:
  
  

**Travel Perks:** Enjoy discounted travel opportunities around the world with SAS.
  
**Health & Wellness:** Access to health and wellness benefits, including a newly renovated gym with complimentary classes such as CrossFit and yoga.
  
**Discounts:** Receive discounts from a wide range of brands, as well as on transportation to and from airports, airport shops, hotels, and car rentals.
  
**Work Environment:** Our office location in Frösundavik offers a vibrant workspace with a restaurant, café, and easy access to outdoor activities in Hagaparken and Brunnsviken. Engage in running, tennis, outdoor gym sessions, kayaking, and stand-up paddling with equipment available free of charge.
  
**Convenient Commute:** Benefit from a non-stop bus service connecting our office to Solna station, and commuter trains, alongside a network of cycle paths.
  
Our Culture at SAS
  
  

At SAS, we are dedicated to caring for each other, delighting our travelers, and driving the transformation towards sustainable aviation. As a future colleague on our team, you'll join a culture where we work collaboratively towards common goals, recognize each other's contributions, and celebrate successes. Our focus is on safe, sustainable, and punctual execution, and we are committed to protecting our planet while transforming SAS for the future. This is an empowering workplace where you can thrive, grow, and take ownership of your work. Join us at SAS and be part of shaping the future of aviation!
  
  

Additional information
  
Apply by September 4, 2026. We review applications continuously and encourage you to apply early, as the position may be filled before the closing date. Please note that, due to GDPR regulations, we cannot accept applications via email.
  
This is a full-time position (100%) based at our headquarters in Frösundavik, Solna, Stockholm. We value in-person collaboration, although flexible working arrangements may be available depending on team and business needs.
  
As this role contributes to security-classified systems and business-critical capabilities, a background check will be conducted as part of the final stage of the recruitment process.
  
  

If you would like to learn more about the role, the team, or how AI, MLOps, and Generative AI are evolving at SAS, feel free to reach out to Warren Edgren, Head of AI & Automation, at warren.edgren@sas.se.
  
  

Please note that applications must be submitted through our careers site, as we are unable to process applications received by email.

title: Product Owner - Hybrid Cloud
description:
Are you ready to take ownership of a strategic hybrid cloud portfolio and help create simpler, smarter, and more automated infrastructure services? Then this could be your next step!


### **Why Sandvik?**

Joining us, you own a strategic service area connecting cloud and on-premises infrastructure in a global IT environment, helping shape the future of hybrid cloud services.


* Shape services across Microsoft Azure, Enterprise Private Cloud, and on-premises infrastructure.
* Drive AI, automation, simplification, and operational excellence in hybrid cloud.
* Collaborate with architects, operations teams, partners, and stakeholders.
* Join the Core IT Services leadership team and contribute to broader strategic decisions.

### **About your job**

As Product Owner for Hybrid Cloud, you own the service direction, roadmap, backlog, and governance for Sandvik’s hybrid infrastructure services. The focus is on making services easy to consume, reducing operational complexity, and increasing automation while ensuring high-quality service delivery through strategic partner governance. You also act as Service Owner, ensuring services continuously evolve in line with business and stakeholder needs.


### **Job responsibilities**

* Define and drive the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for hybrid cloud services.
* Own and prioritize the product backlog based on business needs, value, and strategic direction.
* Govern service delivery partners, ensuring quality, scope, service levels, and lifecycle commitments are met.
* Lead AI and automation initiatives across core operational processes, including provisioning, patching, backup, and billing.
* Drive service governance, stakeholder alignment, risk management, and continuous improvement activities.
* Support the evolution of unified infrastructure management across cloud and on-premises environments.
* Own the budget for the hybrid cloud service area, including forecasting, cost control, and financial accountability for partner spend.

### **Location**

This position is based in Sandviken or Stockholm.


### **Your profile**

You bring experience from product ownership, product management, or a similar role within IT service delivery. Comfortable navigating between strategic priorities and operational governance, you know how to create clarity, manage stakeholders, and drive value in complex environments. You lead the team delivering the product through influence and clear direction — accountable for outcomes and performance, while formal people management sits with the Competence Manager


Your background includes:


* Experience owning or managing infrastructure, hybrid cloud, or managed services in an enterprise IT environment.
* Experience prioritizing backlogs and governing delivery based on business context and stakeholder needs.
* Strong vendor and partner management skills, including accountability for quality, scope, and delivery outcomes.
* Understanding of service lifecycle management, service catalogues, governance, and financial responsibility.
* A commercial mindset, with the ability to negotiate value, manage costs, and hold partners accountable to commercial outcomes — not just delivery
* Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

We see it as a plus if you have experience with agile product practices, ITIL, Microsoft Azure, Azure Arc, AIOps, or cloud financial governance.


Success in this position comes from combining a structured and accountable approach with strong collaboration and communication skills. You’re comfortable making decisions, managing competing priorities, and building trusted relationships across technical and business communities. A proactive mindset and a passion for automation help you create sustainable improvements and long-term value.


### **Our culture**

At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. So, we invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences. Visit our stories hub , LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us further.

Send your application no later than September 1st, 2026. Click apply and include your resume and cover letter in English. Please note that we don’t accept applications by e-mail. Job ID: R0094436.

title: Senior Performance Engineer
description:
**Job Description** **ABOUT THE ROLE**  

In this role, you’ll play a key part in ensuring the performance, scalability, and resilience of H&M’s large-scale system landscape, from SAP platforms and web API backends to smaller in-house applications. You’ll design and execute load, stress, soak, and spike tests across modern microservice architecture using tools like k6 and LoadRunner (or similar).


Beyond testing, you’ll help shape how performance is approached across the organization by building standards, creating automated frameworks, and with that reducing cognitive load for developers. Your work will ensure our systems scale efficiently and degrade gracefully under pressure.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

*Your key responsibilities will include:*

* Developing and maintaining scalable performance testing frameworks that empower developers and product teams to independently design, execute, and analyze tests
* Building internal tools and AI-driven solutions to automate test orchestration, analysis, and reporting
* Leading root cause analysis for performance incidents, identifying bottlenecks from the HTTP layer down to infrastructure and pod scheduling
* Instrumenting and monitoring services using tools such as Splunk and Dynatrace, and creating insightful dashboards and alerts
* Collaborating closely with platform teams to optimize AKS clusters and overall system performance
* Defining performance standards and fostering a strong performance-focused culture across product teams

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**  

You’ll join the Quality Engineering team, a group of experienced and trusted advisors driving performance testing strategies across H&M’s technology landscape.


We are a senior, knowledgeable, and forward-thinking team working with technologies such as k6, Kubernetes, Azure, GCP, SAP, Splunk, and other observability tools.


Just as importantly, we are a collaborative, curious, and enthusiastic team that enjoys working together, solving complex challenges, and continuously improving large-scale systems, while still having fun along the way.

**WHO YOU ARE**

*We are looking for people with*

* 5+ years of experience in performance or reliability engineering within high-traffic distributed systems
* deep technical expertise and a proactive, builder mindset
* Hands-on expertise with performance test tools such as k6, LoadRunner, or similar
* Strong knowledge of Kubernetes (AKS), KEDA, cloud-native infrastructure and observability tools
* Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex performance issues in production environments
* Scripting and automation skills (e.g., Python, Bash, or similar)

*And people who are*

* Able to collaborate easily with others and can connect technical work to product and business goals while communicating clearly with different stakeholders.
* Care about improving how things work, and focus on creating scalable, simple, and efficient solutions in an agile environment.
* Have a strong ability to coach, mentor, and grow engineers
* Are experienced in building high-performing, autonomous teams and skilled in fostering psychological safety, accountability, and continuous improvement


**WHO WE ARE**  

H&M Group is a global company with strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.


We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we use our scale and knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.

**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**

* At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.
* All our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program (HIP)
* Staff discount usable across all H&M Group brands, in stores and online
* Work-life balance, 30 days’ vacation, and wellness allowance of 4000 SEK/year
* Access to Benify for discounts on gym memberships, travel, hotels, and more
* Compensation boost during parental leave

**JOIN US**


Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it is our people who make us who we are.


This is a full-time, permanent position, starting as soon as possible according to agreement. The role is hybrid, based in Stockholm, Sweden, where close collaboration with stakeholders is an important part of the role. **Please note, that we cannot offer visa sponsorship or relocation for this role.** Apply by submitting your CV in English as soon as possible. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through our career page.

*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter.*


Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. We are eager to meet you.

**Job Description**

**System Engineer**

 ***At Icomera, we build technology that keeps people connected while*** ***they’re*** ***on the move. Every day, our solutions deliver fast, reliable internet and digital services on trains, trams, buses, and coaches - supporting millions of passengers across the world.***

***Do you enjoy working close to modern infrastructure platforms while ensuring stability, reliability, and operational excellence? We are looking for a System Engineer who combines strong operational expertise with a passion for automation, continuous improvement, and building resilient infrastructure services.***

**Job type****:** Full-time

**Workplace conditions****:**Hybrid

**Location****:**Gothenburg, Sweden

 **About the** **Role**


You will become part of our IT Operations team and play a key role in ensuring the stability, availability, and continuous improvement of Icomera's infrastructure environments.

  

While the role is primarily focused on operating and maintaining server and infrastructure platforms, you will work closely with Cloud Platform Engineering, Networking Engineering, and Security teams to ensure that our services remain secure, observable, and capable of supporting both business operations and product development.

  

This is a hands-on technical role where you will contribute to everything from daily operations and system lifecycle management to automation initiatives that improve consistency, scalability, and reliability across our environments.

 **Key responsibilities**


In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the infrastructure that supports Icomera's business operations. You will ensure that our server and infrastructure environments remain stable, secure, and well-maintained throughout their lifecycle, while driving automation and operational improvements that increase reliability and reduce manual work. Working closely with Cloud Platform Engineering, Networking, Security, and external vendors, you will contribute to building a resilient and scalable foundation for the business.

 **More specifically, you will:**

* Operate, maintain, and continuously improve server and infrastructure environments across on-prem and cloud platforms.
* Manage the infrastructure lifecycle, including installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, maintenance, and decommissioning.
* Monitor system health and performance, troubleshoot incidents, and contribute to reliable backup, recovery, and security practices.
* Develop and maintain automation, scripts, and tooling to improve efficiency, consistency, and operational quality.
* Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors on troubleshooting, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
* Maintain technical documentation and operational runbooks.
* Participate in the IT Operations on-call rotation and support incident response.
 **Re****quirements**


We're looking for someone with experience in systems engineering, infrastructure operations, or a similar technical role. You have a strong background working with Linux-based environments and enjoy troubleshooting, operating, and improving critical systems in production. You are comfortable working close to the technology and have experience with modern infrastructure environments, including cloud platforms such as AWS, containers, monitoring, and automation.

  

You also understand the importance of security, reliability, and operational excellence in business-critical environments.

 **To succeed in this role, we also believe you have:**

* Experience with automation and configuration management tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or similar.
* Experience with at least one scripting or programming language, such as Python, Bash, or equivalent.
* A good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP.
* Understanding of IT security principles and operational best practices.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience within systems engineering or IT operations.
* Formal education in IT, or equivalent professional experience.
* Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
 **The following skills we see as meritorious:**

* Experience working in cloud and hybrid infrastructure environments.
* Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code and automation practices in production environments.
* Familiarity with database technologies such as PostgreSQL or MariaDB.
 **Who You Are**


To thrive in this role, you are curious, hands-on, and motivated by solving technical challenges. You enjoy understanding how systems work together and take pride in creating stable and reliable infrastructure environments.

  

You work in a structured and methodical way, communicate clearly, and are comfortable documenting your work and sharing knowledge with others.

  

You remain calm under pressure, collaborate effectively across teams, and actively look for opportunities to improve systems, processes, and ways of working.

 **Our Offer**

+ Health is important – we offer a comprehensive health promotion package to our employees
+ Flexible work arrangements – work from home for up to two days a week
+ Electrical bike lease agreement via net salary deduction
+ ITP Pension and collective bargaining agreement
+ A social work environment – board game nights, after works, seasonal parties… The list goes on!

 ***Practical details******:***


We will be reviewing applicants ongoing. Icomera welcomes candidates from all backgrounds, and we value a diverse and inclusive work environment.


We conduct reference checks and background checks as a standard procedure for all final candidates across all recruitment processes.


Icomera is covered by a collective bargaining agreement through TechSverige. Our local union representatives can answer questions related to the collective agreement and union matters at unionen@icomera.com or saco@icomera.com.

  

  

***About Icomera:***


Icomera is the world’s leading provider of integrated connectivity solutions for trains, trams, buses, and coaches, serving millions of passengers and tens of thousands of vehicles on a daily basis. The IcoCrew now consist of 300+ employees globally. Icomera is headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden, with main offices in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Germany, France, Ireland, and Italy.  

Icomera’s vision for green mobility within the public transport industry perfectly complements the wider mission of our parent company, Equans. As the global leader in multi-technical services with 74,000 employees working across 17 country hubs, Equans delivers customised solutions which connect, protect and energise territories, cities, buildings, industries and transport infrastructures, empowering their energy, industrial and digital transitions. Visit www.icomera.com for further information.

title: Manager Infra OPs Architecture
description:
***Shape the future of Dustin’s infrastructure as Manager Infra OPs Architecture, where you’ll lead a team of senior Solution Architects and turn strategic architecture direction into practical roadmaps and technology outcomes. With influence across cloud, data centers, networks, workplace services, security, and platform technologies, you’ll help Dustin evolve its infrastructure for the future.***

**This is what makes the position as Manager Infra OPs Architecture unique**

* **Shape Dustin’s infrastructure future** by translating Enterprise Architecture strategy into practical technology roadmaps and investment priorities.
* **Lead a highly skilled team of senior Solution Architects** and have a visible impact across a complex, international technology landscape.
* **Bridge strategy and execution**, ensuring architectural decisions are scalable, practical, and ready to be implemented and supported


The Hiring Manager for this role is **Jonas Sjöberg, Director of Infrastructure Services & Partner Relations**. As a leader, he focuses on clear ownership, transparency, and keeping things simple, giving people the trust and space to make decisions and move things forward. He cares about building stable and secure infrastructure while continuously improving how we work, embracing automation and new technology to help us scale smarter.


“Sharing is caring” is at the heart of Jonas’s Infrastructure Services & Partner Relations team, creating a strong culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing. The team works closely across Infrastructure, Application Management, and Product & Platform Engineering to keep things simple, secure, and moving forward.

**Your role & influence as Manager Infra OPs Architecture**

*Responsibility*: You will be given responsibility for leading Dustin’s Infrastructure Solution Architecture function and turning strategic architectural direction into actionable roadmaps, solution designs, standards, and implementation guidance across infrastructure domains

 *Collaboration*: Together with your team, you take care of shaping and evolving Dustin’s IT infrastructure platform, collaborating closely with Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure Operations, Product & Platform Engineering, Application Management, Security, and business stakeholders.

*Core Activities:*

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of senior Solution Architects, creating clear ownership, accountability, and a culture of technical excellence.
* Translate Enterprise Architecture principles and target states into practical technology roadmaps, solution designs, and prioritised initiatives.
* Drive architectural governance and cross-domain alignment while identifying modernization opportunities, technical risks, and technical debt.

**Benefits of joining Dustin**


We believe there's more to Dustin than just the benefits listed here. You'll fully understand this once you're with us. Curious? Our Life at Dustin page has you covered.

**You can find more of our Swedish benefits below in the vacancy.**

**This is what we imagine you bring**


We envision you as an experienced and empowering technology leader who combines strategic thinking with strong execution, knows how to lead senior experts through influence, trust, and clear accountability, and excels at turning complex architectural ambitions into practical roadmaps and measurable outcomes. You don’t need to be the deepest technical expert in every domain, but you know how to create direction, align stakeholders, challenge the status quo, and help your teams turn expertise into business and technology results.


Additionally, it’s important that:

* You have a bachelor’s degree level of working and thinking, or equivalent experience within Information Technology.
* You have **3–5 years of proven people leadership experience** managing Solution Architects, Infrastructure Architects, Senior Engineers, or similar technical specialists.
* Experience leading teams in large-scale, complex enterprise environments with multiple technologies, stakeholders, and competing priorities.
* Experience translating architectural strategy into technology roadmaps, implementation plans, and prioritised initiatives.
* Broad knowledge across infrastructure domains such as cloud, data centers, networking, workplace technologies, security, automation, and platform services.
* Experience with architecture governance, solution reviews, modernization initiatives, and strategic technology decisions.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders at different levels of the organisation.

**What can you expect next?**


To ensure a fair recruitment process free from unconscious bias, we handle your application anonymously and do not accept cover letters. Please refrain from sending one, so that the selection is based solely on professional competencies. We expect the following steps in the recruitment process:

* Telephone screening with TA Partner, Karishma
* First interview with the Hiring Manager, Jonas
* Second/ Technical Interview with the Hiring Manager and another colleague.
* Professional References and Background check and verification.

***Please note that for this specific job, we don´t provide any relocation or work permit sponsorship support.***

title: Visiting Associate - Stockholm | BCG Platinion
description:

Help us deploy customized platforms, architectures, strategies, and organizations to leverage the digital potential of our customers and drive true innovation, with state-of-the-art tools such as cloud computing, AI, blockchain, microservices, and containerization.
