title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
**Join CellaVision and Help Shape the Future of Laboratory Diagnostics**


Are you passionate about technology, problem-solving, and helping customers succeed? Do you enjoy working with advanced instruments, software, and IT systems in an international environment? If so, this could be your next challenge.


At CellaVision, we are transforming laboratory diagnostics through intelligent microscopy and digital imaging. As a global leader in digital microscopy solutions, we develop and deliver innovative instruments, software, and reagents used by healthcare professionals around the world. Our solutions help laboratories improve efficiency, accuracy, and diagnostic certainty—ultimately contributing to better patient care.


Working at CellaVision means being part of a company at the forefront of technology, combining advances in software development, digital imaging, chemistry, and machine learning. Here, your work has a real impact on healthcare while offering exciting opportunities for professional growth and development.

**The Opportunity**


As a Technical Support Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring our customers and partners receive world-class technical support and service. You will work closely with laboratories, distributors, and colleagues across the organization to solve technical challenges, deliver training, and support the successful implementation and operation of our products.


This is a varied role where no two days are the same. One day you may be troubleshooting a complex software or network issue remotely, and the next you could be conducting training, installing systems, or supporting a customer on-site.


You will be part of the Customer Support team based in Lund, supporting customers and partners across multiple markets.

**Your Responsibilities**


As a Technical Support Engineer, you will:

* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues remotely and occasionally on-site at customer locations.
* Investigate and replicate customer-reported issues in an in-house environment to identify root causes and solutions.
* Install instruments and software, perform preventive maintenance, and carry out repairs at customer sites.
* Deliver technical support and expertise to customers, distributors, and internal stakeholders.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with distributors' service organizations and support their development.
* Design, plan, and conduct technical training sessions both remotely and on-site.
* Participate in customer seminars, workshops, and educational activities.
* Collaborate closely with R&D, Product Management, Quality, and other internal functions to continuously improve customer support processes.
* Contribute to service documentation, technical notes, training materials, and service manuals.
* Gather customer feedback and market insights to support future product development and improvements.


Travel within Europe and occasionally internationally is required as part of the role, including customer visits, installations, training, and support activities, amounting to approximately 20 days per year.

**Who You Are**


You enjoy working in a customer-facing role and are motivated by solving complex technical challenges. You have a structured and analytical approach to problem-solving and take pride in delivering excellent service.


You are comfortable communicating with different audiences, whether troubleshooting with a laboratory technician, training a distributor, or presenting to a larger group. Most importantly, you enjoy collaborating with others and contributing to a positive team environment.

**Qualifications**


To succeed in this role, we believe you have:

* A degree in engineering or another relevant technical field, or equivalent work experience.
* A strong interest in technology and a solid understanding of IT systems, Windows environments, computer hardware, and network infrastructure.
* The ability to investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve software, hardware, and connectivity-related issues.
* Experience delivering technical training, education, or customer support.
* Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.


Experience from the medical device, laboratory, diagnostics, or healthcare industry is considered an advantage but is not required.

**Why Join CellaVision?**


At CellaVision, we believe that innovation starts with people. We foster a culture built on collaboration, continuous improvement, recognition, and respect. We encourage new ideas, support professional growth, and believe that having fun together is an important part of success.


We offer:

* Competitive benefits through our collective agreement.
* Wellness allowance and access to an on-site gym.
* Team activities, company events, and social initiatives.
* Opportunities to work with cutting-edge technology that makes a difference in healthcare worldwide.

**Diversity Is in Our Blood**


At CellaVision, we understand not only the uniqueness of blood cells but also of people. We believe diversity drives innovation and helps us build better solutions for our customers and patients.


We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to contribute. Qualified applicants are considered for employment regardless of race, nationality, ethnic or social origin, age, religion, political beliefs, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, family status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

**About CellaVision**


Founded in Sweden in 1994, CellaVision is a global medical technology company dedicated to improving the analysis of blood and body fluid samples through digital microscopy and intelligent image analysis.


Today, we are approximately 250 employees with our global headquarters in Lund, Sweden. We have market support offices in 16 countries, customers in more than 40 markets, and reagent development and manufacturing in Martillac, France.


Together, we are helping laboratories around the world improve diagnostic workflows and patient care.


For more information, visit www.cellavision.com.

title: HIL automation engineer
description:
**Work with us towards a greener future**  

Climate change is a reality. As a mobility provider, we recognise our impact on the environment and are determined to play our part in contributing to sustainable solutions. And it’s so exciting – we’re well on our way on our journey towards full electrification. If you share our commitment for creating a positive environmental impact, then join us in our mission to advance towards a greener future.

**Let's introduce ourselves**
-----------------------------



The Power Electronics Software department at Volvo Cars is proud of being one of the most successful players within SW development for Electric Vehicles. We are responsible for delivering system solutions and SW functionality for the power electronics in our electrified vehicles. Our vision is to deliver the best and most innovative functions to the market and continuously evolve our software platform.  

  

Our team consists of passionate and enthusiastic people with a mix of personalities and nationalities. There is a high focus on collaboration and communication within the group and new members always get a warm welcome, support and acceptance.

**What you'll do**
------------------



You will be an important player in forming our component HIL test automation, with elements that will enable totally new possibilities and ways of working. Together with your cross-department colleagues, you will be responsible for developing test automation scripts, keeping the test scripts up to date and fully functional to enable manual and fully automated test flow in our continuous integration tool chain.  

  

Out team, the Integration and Release team, is responsible for the development of automatic SW integration, release and the continuous deployment process for power electronics. We work with maintenance of CI/CD toolchain and SW integration and qualification testing. We are also responsible for inventory, specification and maintenance of HIL test environments as well as have ownership of the releases from Power Electronics SW.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------



You are someone with a passion for the development of complex systems within vehicle electrification and embedded systems. You are devoted to driving engineering challenges all the way from the concept stage to mass production.  

  

You have a senior background within the field of test automation, test infrastructure, test setup, and a natural initiator who commits to delivering the team's deliverables with high precision on quality. You are a team player who contributes and brings out the best from your fellow team members and work actively to increase your network. You hold a Bachelor or Master's degree within Electrical, Electronics, Controls Theory, Signals & Systems, Data or Mechatronics.  

  

Furthermore, you have at least 4 years of relevant experience from:  

  

* Component HIL test automation
* HIL systems such as dSPACE, Vector, INCA or similar
* Documented programming experience in Python
* Configuration management, version control and test management tools
* Tools for handling calibration as well as scripting for automating testing towards our Continuous Integration chain
* Troubleshooting SW and HW issues on the HIL to keep test systems up and running 24/7

  

Meritorious:  

  

* Experience with domain HIL, SIL or VIL is an added advantage.
* Experience in managing the test inventory, managing the test objects and HIL environments.
* Experience in handling the test objects and HILs for planning, commissioning, prioritization, and stability
* Driving license
**Volvo Cars. For Life.**  

For nearly a century, Volvo Cars has empowered people to move freely in a personal, sustainable and safe way. Today, we are driving bold advancements in electrification, sustainability and automotive safety. To realise our ambitious vision, we are seeking innovative minds who are ready to tackle the challenges of tomorrow – today.  

  

In our company, we believe extraordinary things are achieved by ordinary people with the drive to make a difference.  

  

**Ready to take the next step?**  

Submit your CV in English and tell us why you’re the ideal candidate for a new role at Volvo Cars. Applications must be received no later than [XXth of XX XXX]. We are prioritising direct applications to ensure a fair and efficient application process.  

  

For specific questions about the position, please reach out to Hiring Manager Daniel Larsson at DANIEL.J.LARSSON@VOLVOCARS.COM.  

  

As part of the recruitment process, the final candidates might undergo a background check.  

  

We welcome your application!

description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.
   

  

*We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week.  We are looking for a software integration engineer who can champion the delivery of features in our newest product. This involves working across software and hardware to ensure that the full system is integrated together seamlessly when it needs to be delivered to the customer.

* Deliver full-system features that span software and hardware that meet customer requirements
* Directly interact with the customers at the customer site to identify the target use-cases, then manage the project to complete the integration
* Work cross-functionally with the product, software, mechanical and electrical teams to develop and deploy systems

* Design and bring up test rigs needed for end-to-end testing and validation of system performance
